items.title: E-commerce Main Image - Four-Model Earbud Product Comparison
items.titleZh: 电商主图-四款耳塞产品对比
items.promptZh:
目标：创建一个清晰的比较网格，显示由四个 AI 图像模型渲染的相同电子商务产品：白色工作室背景上打开盖子的光滑白色真无线耳机充电盒。

画布：宽 16:9 图像，由浅灰色垂直和水平细分隔线正好分为 4 个相等的象限。最小的白色背景，每个产品下的柔和阴影，高调的产品摄影外观。

布局：在 2 × 2 网格中恰好排列 4 个产品渲染，每个渲染都位于其象限的中心，其下方有一个粗体黑色模型标签。保留充足的空白并将所有标签对齐在每个象限的下部附近。

象限和标签：
1. 左上：白色圆角矩形充电盒，以四分之三角打开，里面放着两个耳塞，半透明的盖子，柔和的反光。标签：“{参数名称=“左上标签”默认=“gemini-3-pro-image-preview（Nanobanana Pro）”}”。
2. 右上：圆形药丸状白色充电盒打开，里面有两个 AirPods 式耳机，正面有微妙的绿色指示点。标签：“{参数名称=“右上角标签”默认=“doubao-seedream-5-0-pro”}”。
3. 左下：正面有光泽的白色充电盒，盖子打开，两个直立的耳塞，耳机上有黑色椭圆形小扬声器通风孔，充电盒正面有小点指示器。标签：“{参数名称=“左下标签”默认=“gpt-image-2”}”。
4. 右下角：正面有光泽的白色充电盒，带有打开的半透明盖子，两个圆形耳塞位于内部低处，没有长柄，白色小指示点和正面的黑色小充电端口。标签：“{参数名称=“右下标签”默认=“gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview (Nanobanana 2)”}”。

视觉风格：优质电商主形象，逼真的白色塑料和硅胶材料，抛光表面，微妙的灰色反射，柔和的工作室灯光，清晰的产品结构，浅接触阴影，无装饰道具。

限制：仅使用 4 个象限和 4 个标签；请勿添加徽标、水印、额外文本、手、包装或彩色背景。使所有产品保持白色并居中，左下渲染对应于 {argument name="highlighted model" default="gpt-image-2"}。
items.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean comparison grid showing the same e-commerce product rendered by four AI image models: a glossy white true wireless earbud charging case with the lid open, on a white studio background.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image, divided into exactly 4 equal quadrants by thin light-gray vertical and horizontal divider lines. Minimal white background, soft shadows under each product, high-key product photography look.

Layout: Arrange exactly 4 product renders in a 2 × 2 grid, each centered in its quadrant with a bold black model label beneath it. Keep generous whitespace and align all labels near the lower part of each quadrant.

Quadrants and labels:
1. Top-left: white rounded rectangular charging case open at a three-quarter angle, two earbuds resting inside, semi-transparent lid, soft reflections. Label: “{argument name="top left label" default="gemini-3-pro-image-preview(Nanobanana Pro)"}”.
2. Top-right: rounded pill-shaped white charging case open, two AirPods-style stem earbuds inside, subtle green indicator dot on the front. Label: “{argument name="top right label" default="doubao-seedream-5-0-pro"}”.
3. Bottom-left: front-facing glossy white charging case with open lid, two stem earbuds standing upright, small black oval speaker vents on the buds, tiny dot indicator on the case front. Label: “{argument name="bottom left label" default="gpt-image-2"}”.
4. Bottom-right: front-facing glossy white charging case with open translucent lid, two rounded earbuds sitting low inside without long stems, small white indicator dot and tiny black charging port on the front. Label: “{argument name="bottom right label" default="gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview (Nanobanana 2)"}”.

Visual style: premium e-commerce main image, realistic white plastic and silicone materials, polished surfaces, subtle gray reflections, soft studio lighting, crisp product structure, shallow contact shadows, no decorative props.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 quadrants and exactly 4 labels; do not add logos, watermarks, extra text, hands, packaging, or colored backgrounds. Keep all products white and centered, with the bottom-left render corresponding to {argument name="highlighted model" default="gpt-image-2"}.

items.promptZh: 创建一个逼真的产品风格图像，将定制的可收藏动作玩偶密封在透明泡罩包装内，直立在木制办公桌上。该人物是一位年轻的成年女性，留着及肩的柔软棕色头发和刘海，友善的微笑和自然的妆容，风格像一个高品质逼真的微型雕像，皮肤和衣服都涂有哑光漆。她穿着一件清爽的白色纽扣衬衫，塞进高腰米色阔腿裤和白色高跟鞋。让她自信地站着，手里拿着两个配件：左臂下夹着一台纤薄的银色笔记本电脑或平板电脑，右手拿着一个带有绿色吸管的塑料冰咖啡杯。该包装有一个淡薄荷绿色的圆角背衬卡和一个位于顶部中心的小型零售悬挂槽，覆盖有光滑透明的模制塑料外壳，具有逼真的反射、圆形边缘和图形轮廓。以轻微的视线角度从正面展示泡罩包装，位于框架中央，在小型透明展示底座上，人物从头到脚完全可见。背景：柔和模糊的现代工作空间，左边是一台打开的笔记本电脑，右边是绿叶植物，最右边背景的桌子上还有另一个冰咖啡杯。使用自然光、浅景深、木桌面上的真实阴影、优质的商业摄影质量、没有可见的品牌徽标、包装上没有文字。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic product-style image of a custom collectible action figure sealed inside a clear blister pack, standing upright on a wooden office desk. The figure is a young adult woman with shoulder-length soft brown hair and bangs, a friendly smile, and natural makeup, styled like a high-quality realistic miniature figurine with matte painted skin and clothing. Pose her standing confidently, holding exactly 2 accessories: a slim silver laptop or tablet tucked under her left arm and a plastic iced coffee cup with a green straw in her right hand. The packaging has a pale mint-green backing card with rounded corners and a small retail hanging slot centered at the top, covered by a glossy transparent molded plastic shell with realistic reflections, rounded edges, and figure-shaped contours. Show the blister pack from the front at a slight eye-level angle, centered in the frame, with the figure fully visible from head to feet on a small clear display base. Background: softly blurred modern workspace with an open laptop on the left, leafy green plant on the right, and another iced coffee cup on the desk in the far right background. Use natural daylight, shallow depth of field, realistic shadows on the wooden tabletop, premium commercial photography quality, no visible brand logos, no text on the package.

Main sign: A clear rectangular acrylic board with rounded corners, subtle reflections, glossy edges, and printed/neon-looking pastel graphics. Use pink, cyan, lavender, and white glow effects as if the graphics are lit from within.

Along both vertical edges, place repeated glowing triangle icons in pink and cyan; make exactly 10 large triangle outlines total, 5 on the left edge and 5 on the right edge.

Menu layout: White semi-transparent printed menu panel on the acrylic, with two centered neon section headers.

items.promptZh: 从后面看，一名{argument name="subject" default="孤独的摩托车手，穿着时尚的黑色皮夹克和头盔"}，骑着一辆{argument name="vehicle" default="dark 现代摩托车"}沿着超现实的、无限的表面行驶，与光的漩涡融为一体。视角居中且较低，通过数字未来隧道营造出强烈的高速运动感。地板看起来像一个反光的深色玻璃状平面，上面有{argument name="light color" default="电蓝色、白色和充满活力的橙黄色火焰"}的强烈光迹。背景是消失的地平线上一个明亮、令人眼花缭乱的光点，周围是模拟超高速旅行的万花筒垂直光条纹爆炸。灯光具有电影般的、高对比度和动态的效果，摩托车发光的红色尾灯在混乱、流动的环境中提供了一个尖锐的锚点。整体氛围紧张、刺激、空灵，让人想起控制论速度和超凡脱俗的旅程的主题。逼真、8k 分辨率、戏剧性的运动模糊、对摩托车的清晰聚焦、皮革和金属部件的复杂纹理、合成波调色板、超详细渲染。 -
items.prompt: A {argument name="subject" default="lone motorcyclist wearing a sleek black leather jacket and helmet"}, viewed from behind, riding a {argument name="vehicle" default="dark modern motorcycle"} along a surreal, infinite surface that blends into a vortex of light. The perspective is centered and low, creating a powerful sense of high-speed motion through a digital, futuristic tunnel. The floor appears as a reflective, dark glass-like plane streaked with intense light trails in {argument name="light colors" default="electric blues, whites, and vibrant orange-yellow flames"}. The background is a brilliant, blinding point of light at the vanishing horizon, surrounded by a kaleidoscopic explosion of vertical light streaks that simulate hyper-speed travel. The lighting is cinematic, high-contrast, and dynamic, with the motorcycle's glowing red taillight providing a sharp anchor point against the chaotic, fluid surroundings. The overall atmosphere is intense, adrenaline-fueled, and ethereal, evoking themes of cybernetic speed and otherworldly journeys. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, dramatic motion blur, sharp focus on the motorcycle, intricate textures of leather and metallic components, synthwave color palette, hyper-detailed rendering. -

items.title: 教室少女挥手CG
items.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime visual-novel CG screenshot of a bright high school classroom scene, in the highly detailed glossy style associated with modern GPT Image 2 anime illustrations.

Canvas: 16:9 widescreen game screenshot, approximately 1200×675, cinematic composition with a visual novel dialogue UI overlay along the bottom. Warm spring daylight, soft bloom, crisp linework, detailed painterly shading.

Layout: Foreground left shows the back and side profile of 1 teenage boy seated at a desk, facing the heroine; he has messy short black hair and wears a dark navy hoodie. Midground right is 1 teenage girl seated at the opposite desk, smiling and raising her right hand in a friendly wave. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"} tied in a high side ponytail with loose strands, blue eyes, round glasses, and a gentle cheerful expression. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="a cream-white cable-knit turtleneck sweater"}. The camera angle is over the boy’s shoulder, making the girl the focal point.

Classroom details: Include exactly 2 main characters: 1 boy seen from behind and 1 girl facing the viewer. Include exactly 6 visible student desks with wooden tops and metal frames: 1 boy’s foreground desk, 1 girl’s desk, 2 empty desks behind her, 1 partial desk at far right, and 1 partial desk near the window. Include 3 large window panels on the left/back wall showing blue sky, distant buildings, and blooming pink cherry blossoms outside. Add soft drifting cherry blossom petals and sunbeams across the room. Include 1 green chalkboard on the back right wall with handwritten welcome text {argument name="chalkboard text" default="電気工事科 1年1組 ようこそ！"} plus small sakura doodles, and 1 bulletin board with pinned papers beside it.

Desk props: On the central desk include exactly 3 study items: 1 open notebook with Ohm’s law notes showing a triangle labeled V, I, R and the formula “V = I × R”; 1 pen lying diagonally near the notebook; and 1 thick textbook with colorful tabs titled {argument name="textbook title" default="電気理論の基礎"} with smaller Japanese subtitle text about electrical circuits and calculations.

Visual novel UI: Add a dark translucent navy dialogue box spanning the bottom 18% of the image. It has 1 small blue name tag on the left reading {argument name="speaker name" default="奈緒"}, 1 line of Japanese dialogue in white text, a small downward triangle at the right end of the dialogue, and a row of tiny game controls along the bottom right such as BACK, AUTO, SKIP, SAVE, LOAD, CONFIG, LOG, MENU. Add a small stylized site/logo mark in the bottom left, similar to a game screenshot watermark.

Style constraints: Clean anime faces, luminous eyes, fine hair strands, realistic classroom perspective, soft rim lighting, high-detail fabric texture on the sweater, warm nostalgic mood, no extra characters, no cropped face for the girl, no photorealism, no 3D render look.

items.title: 赛博天使角色设定图
items.promptZh:
目标：为官方 AAA 科幻游戏角色圣经创建超详细的 16:9 未来派动漫角色设计表，其中包括 {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"} 和副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="Pink Protocol"}。

画布：宽水平 16:9 白色编辑字符表画布、干净的高级 UI 演示、薄浅灰色分隔线、洋红色和黑色网络界面标题、大量负空间、清晰的高分辨率线条。

布局：将工作表分为三个主要区域。左第三：角色的大型全身英雄插图，自信地站立，稍微转向观众，一只手做出和平手势。中/右：技术模型表和设计参考面板。最右边：垂直详细信息列。

角色详细信息：可爱的未来派动漫女孩，身材苗条，长长的飘逸{argument name="hair color" default="white-blonde"}头发带有柔和的粉红色调，明亮的青蓝色眼睛，猫耳网络耳机，小天线装饰品，粉红色的心形图案，光滑的科幻配件，以及俏皮的偶像机甲美学。套装是一套粉色、白色和黑色的网络天使街头服饰战斗服：心形胸甲、短款上衣、带有粉色饰边的超大蓬松白色袖子、短百褶裙、实用腰带、大腿带、吊袜带、不对称长筒袜（包括一件渔网袜和一件白色高科技紧身裤）、厚底厚底战斗靴、小兔子吊饰细节、电缆、链条和小型机械附件。添加一个大型粉红色背包式网络单元，带有圆形心核和悬垂的电缆，末端有兔子饰物。

左侧英雄区域：将标题文本放在左上角，以粗体深色字体显示 {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"}，并在下面显示一条较小的行“// PINK PROTOCOL”。在角色附近添加一个带有 X 眼的带翅膀的兔子脸的简单粉色涂鸦标志。在她的肩膀附近包括一个漂浮的圆形粉红色机器人宠物，它有小翅膀、兔子般的耳朵、黑色圆形数字脸和有光泽的亮点。

中心模型表：添加带标签的标题“模型表”。准确显示同一角色的 3 个较小的全身转身姿势，均匀间隔并用粉红色标签标记：“前”、“侧”和“后”。正面朝前，侧面朝左，背面是长发和大号圆形心形背包。

右侧详细信息列：添加标签标题“DETAILS”。包括 5 个堆叠的特写面板：1) 头部和网络猫耳耳机，2) 胸甲和心脏顶部，3) 背包心脏核心装置和侧面模块，4) 大腿带/吊袜带和小腿技术细节，5) 厚实的粉白色厚底靴。

底部参考区域：添加一个标记为“武器和宠物”的部分，其中包含 2 个物品：粉白色的未来派链式武器或带有魅力的机械手杖，以及圆形粉红色有翅膀的机器人宠物。添加一个标记为“调色板”的部分，其中包含 6 个方形样本：亮粉色、柔和的彩虹渐变、近白色、浅粉色、深炭色和浅青色。

视觉风格：超详细的抛光动漫概念艺术、精致干净的墨线、柔和的卡通阴影、微妙的柔和渐变、光滑的塑料和金属亮点、网络卡哇伊科幻设计语言、专业的游戏艺术参考表、带有洋红色 UI 口音的白色背景。

限制：保留所有英文标签，保留 3 个转身姿势、5 个细节面板、2 个武器和宠物物品以及 6 个色样的精确计数。没有多余的字符，没有水印，没有凌乱的背景，没有写实的摄影。

Goal: Create an ultra-detailed 16:9 futuristic anime character design sheet for an official AAA sci-fi game character bible, featuring {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"} with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle" default="Pink Protocol"}.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 white editorial character-sheet canvas, clean premium UI presentation, thin pale gray dividers, magenta and black cyber-interface headers, lots of negative space, crisp high-resolution linework.

Layout: Split the sheet into three main zones. Left third: a large full-body hero illustration of the character, standing confidently, slightly turned toward the viewer, one hand making a peace sign. Center/right: technical model sheet and design reference panels. Far right: vertical details column.

Character details: Cute futuristic anime girl, slim build, long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="white-blonde"} hair with soft pink accents, bright cyan-blue eyes, cat-ear cyber headphones, small antenna ornaments, pink heart motifs, glossy sci-fi accessories, and a playful idol-mecha aesthetic. Outfit is a pink, white, and black cyber angel streetwear battle suit: heart-shaped chest armor, cropped top, oversized puffy white sleeves with pink trim, short pleated skirt, utility belt, thigh straps, garters, asymmetrical stockings including one fishnet stocking and one white tech legging, chunky platform combat boots, tiny bunny charm details, cables, chains, and small mechanical attachments. Add a large pink backpack-like cyber unit with a circular heart core and dangling cable ending in a bunny charm.

Left hero area: Place the title text at the top left reading {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"} in bold dark lettering, with a smaller line beneath reading “// PINK PROTOCOL”. Add a simple pink doodle emblem of a winged bunny face with X eyes near the character. Include a floating round pink robot pet near her shoulder, with tiny wings, rabbit-like ears, a black circular digital face, and glossy highlights.

Center model sheet: Add a labeled header “MODEL SHEET”. Show exactly 3 smaller full-body turnaround poses of the same character, evenly spaced and labeled with pink tabs: “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. The front view faces forward, the side view faces left in profile, and the back view shows long hair and the large circular heart-core backpack.

Bottom reference area: Add a section labeled “WEAPON & PET” containing exactly 2 items: a pink-white futuristic chained weapon or mechanical staff with charms, and the round pink winged robot pet. Add a section labeled “COLOR PALETTE” with exactly 6 square swatches: hot pink, pastel rainbow gradient, near-white, pale pink, dark charcoal, and light cyan.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed polished anime concept art, delicate clean ink lines, soft cel shading, subtle pastel gradients, glossy plastic and metallic highlights, cyber-kawaii sci-fi design language, professional game art reference sheet, white background with magenta UI accents.

Constraints: Keep all labels in English, preserve the exact count of 3 turnaround poses, 5 detail panels, 2 weapon-and-pet items, and 6 color swatches. No extra characters, no watermark, no messy background, no realistic photography.

items.title: 粉彩偶像小丑扑克牌
items.promptZh:
目标：制作一张华丽的动漫风格小丑扑克牌，以可爱的魔法偶像女孩为主题，以柔和的嘉年华幻想为主题，适合作为收藏的定制王牌。

画布：垂直纸牌格式，带圆角、全出血插图、柔软的象牙色纸牌边缘和极其细致的镀金边框。使用以粉色、淡蓝色、奶油色、薰衣草色和金色为主的柔和色调，并带有闪亮的虹彩亮点。

布局：中心一名全身动漫女孩，摆出动态的姿势，仿佛漂浮或向前跳跃。她对观众灿烂地微笑，举起的左手拿着一张小扑克牌，右手向外伸出。在两侧添加垂直文本：{argument name="cardrank text" default="JOKER"}：一个沿左边缘直立，一个沿右边缘倒置。恰好放置 3 个皇冠徽章：左上角有一个圆形皇冠徽章，右下角有一个圆形皇冠徽章，底部中央有一个较大的皇冠徽章。卡片周围饰有分层的金丝、涡卷、细绿松石和粉红色的强调线、小宝石和装饰性角饰。

主题详细信息：该角色是{argument name="character name" default="an Original Pastel Joker Girl"}，一位年轻的动漫偶像，留着蓬松的波波头短发，{argument name="hair color" default="棉花糖粉色在发尖处逐渐变成淡蓝色"}，一双闪闪发光的蓝粉色大眼睛，红润的脸颊和开朗的笑容。她穿着一件柔软的小丑风格迷你连衣裙，颜色为{argument name="outfitcolors"default="pink,white,babyblue,andgold"}：露肩荷叶边上衣、荷叶边泡泡袖、丝带肩带、珍珠和珠宝配饰、花饰、一条镶有宝石的小项圈、带蕾丝的分层短裙、半透明荷叶边和小蝴蝶结细节。添加一顶带有悬挂金铃的倾斜小小丑帽或软帽，再加上花朵发夹和蓝色发夹。

姿势和服装数量：包括 1 个女孩、1 张凸起的扑克牌、1 个小丑帽、1 个项圈、2 个腕带、2 条可见的腿和 2 条不匹配的长筒袜：左边的长筒袜是粉红色和白色的水平条纹，右边的长筒袜是淡蓝白相间的钻石丑角图案。添加华丽的鞋子或脚踝装饰，配有丝带、鲜花和小金铃铛。

背景：梦幻般的奇幻游乐园内部，配有柔和的散景灯、半透明丝带、柔和的丑角钻石图案、漂浮的闪光以及微弱的旋转木马或马戏团帐篷形状。正好包括 2 条大卷曲丝带，一条蓝色丝带从左侧流出，一根粉红色丝带从右侧流出。保持背景明亮且忙碌，但对比度低于角色。

视觉风格：高度抛光的日本动漫插图，精致的线条，水彩般的柔和渐变，闪闪发光的宝石亮点，蕾丝和珍珠细节，魔法少女美学，华丽的洛可可扑克牌设计，柔和的绽放灯光，非常高的细节，对称的卡片框架，无照片写实主义。

限制：保留干净的扑克牌构图，没有多余的字符，没有现代徽标，没有水印，没有逼真的手，没有黑暗的恐怖气氛，并且除了重复的{argument name =“cardrank text”default =“JOKER”}之外没有其他可读文本。
items.prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate anime-style joker playing card featuring a cute magical idol girl in a pastel carnival fantasy theme, suitable as a collectible custom trump card.

Canvas: Vertical playing-card format with rounded corners, full-bleed illustration, soft ivory card edges, and an extremely detailed gilded border. Use a pastel palette dominated by pink, baby blue, cream, lavender, and gold, with sparkling iridescent highlights.

Layout: Center one full-body anime girl posed dynamically as if floating or leaping forward. She smiles brightly at the viewer, holding one small playing card in her raised left hand while her right hand reaches outward. Add vertical text reading {argument name="card rank text" default="JOKER"} on both sides: one upright along the left edge and one upside-down along the right edge. Place exactly 3 crown emblems: one circular crown medallion at the top-left corner, one circular crown medallion at the bottom-right corner, and one larger crown crest centered at the bottom. Surround the card with layered gold filigree, scrollwork, thin turquoise and pink accent lines, tiny gems, and decorative corner flourishes.

Subject details: The character is {argument name="character name" default="an original pastel joker girl"}, a youthful anime idol with a short fluffy bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="cotton-candy pink fading into pale blue at the tips"}, big sparkling blue-pink eyes, rosy cheeks, and an open cheerful smile. She wears a soft jester-inspired mini dress in {argument name="outfit colors" default="pink, white, baby blue, and gold"}: off-shoulder ruffled bodice, frilly puff sleeves, ribbon straps, pearl and jewel accents, floral ornaments, a tiny choker with a gem, layered short skirt with lace, translucent ruffles, and small bow details. Add a small tilted pastel jester hat or bonnet with dangling gold bells, plus flower hair clips and blue hairpins.

Pose and costume count: Include exactly 1 girl, 1 raised playing card, 1 jester hat, 1 choker, 2 wrist cuffs, 2 visible legs, and 2 mismatched thigh-high stockings: the left stocking is pink-and-white horizontal striped, and the right stocking is pale blue-and-white diamond harlequin patterned. Add ornate shoes or ankle decorations with ribbons, flowers, and small gold bells.

Background: A dreamy fantasy amusement-park interior with soft bokeh lights, translucent ribbons, pastel harlequin diamond patterns, floating sparkles, and faint carousel or circus-tent shapes. Include exactly 2 large curling ribbons, one blue ribbon flowing from the left side and one pink ribbon flowing from the right side. Keep the background luminous and busy but lower contrast than the character.

Visual style: Highly polished Japanese anime illustration, delicate linework, watercolor-like pastel gradients, glittering jewel highlights, lace and pearl details, magical-girl aesthetic, ornate rococo playing-card design, soft bloom lighting, very high detail, symmetrical card framing, no photorealism.

Constraints: Preserve a clean playing-card composition with no extra characters, no modern logo, no watermark, no realistic hands, no dark horror mood, and no additional readable text beyond the repeated {argument name="card rank text" default="JOKER"}.

items.title: 绿窗咖啡馆眨眼少女
items.promptZh:
主题：
一只眼睛在绿色的窗户旁眨眼

主题：
一张胸部特写肖像，照片中一位年轻女子穿着{argument name="clothing" default="white lace-trimmed dress"}，单手托着脸颊，在{argument name="background" default="绿树环绕的明亮咖啡馆"}的木桌上闭着一只眼睛微笑。人物脸部和上半身从中心向左放大，右下角有柠檬饮料，前景有淡粉色装置，窗外有树木。

人物/表情：
一张小而圆的椭圆形脸微微向右倾斜，下巴微微内收。屏幕左侧那只深棕色的大眼睛向前看，而右侧的眼睛眨眼间就完全闭上了。细长的棕色眉毛，挺拔的小鼻子，友善的微笑，淡粉色的嘴唇紧闭，嘴角向上翘起。白皙的皮肤搭配淡粉色的脸颊。长长的深棕色头发垂至胸部，在中央附近分开，沿着脸颊形成细细的刘海和发丝，松散的头发长长地垂在双肩上，尤其是在右侧胸部前面。

服装/姿势：
暖白色无袖长裙。细肩带和深 V 领饰有配套的小蕾丝，细褶皱从胸部下方蔓延，薄面料上有精致的垂直皱纹。脖子上有一条超细金链，上面有一个透明的小吊坠，右手腕上有一条{argument name="accessory" default="淡金手镯"}。坐姿前倾，朝向桌子，用手掌和右手弯曲的手指支撑右脸。左臂向前伸出，在左下角处切断。

背景/灯光：
前景是一张明亮的木纹圆桌。右下角是透明饮料，里面有柠檬片和冰块、黑色吸管和圆形藤制杯垫。下部中央是淡粉色外壳中的三镜头设备。背景由黑色窗框、大玻璃、茂密的绿叶、白色藤椅、木柱和右后方的露台组成。柔和的午后光线从左上方的窗外射入，均匀地照亮了脸部、头发、肩膀和桌子，在脸颊和手臂下投射出薄薄的阴影。

构图/相机：
3:4 宽高比。相机处于几乎水平的视线高度，略高于坐着的拍摄对象的眼睛，从头顶到胸部底部和桌子边缘拍摄胸部特写。人物尺寸较大，约为屏幕高度的四分之三，脸部位于上半部分的中央，支撑脸颊的手位于右侧中央，胸部位于左下角。饮料在右边缘被部分切断，而设备在底边缘被部分切断。清晰的焦点集中在睁开的眼睛和嘴唇上，背景树叶柔和地模糊。

质地/风格：
以白色、浅木色、鲜绿色和浅黄色为基调的高清逼真照片。自然地描绘出细腻的皮肤、光泽的嘴唇、稀疏的头发、蕾丝和薄织物、冰和柠檬、木纹以及窗外树叶的散景。

负面：
不要改变眨眼的表情和支撑脸颊的手；不要移除柠檬饮料和浅粉色装置。
items.prompt:
Theme:
One eye winking by a green window

items.promptZh:
面部身份：
使用附带的面部身份作为唯一面部参考。四张照片必须让这位女性一眼就能被认出完全是同一个人。

身体：
成年女性，二十出头。使用附带的身体参考作为身体比例的唯一参考，保持真实解剖结构、自然曲线、均衡比例和真实皮肤质感。

主题：
唐代彩色摄影实验：夜游东市、曲池泛舟、坊内蹴鞠（古代足球）、曲江春宴。

主体：
生成四张独立的 2:3 竖版写实照片，不要拼贴。人物身份保持一致，但发型、服装、动作、机位和摄影语言必须根据各自场景合理变化。

第一张照片：“东市灯影中的忽然一笑”：
人物走在人潮拥挤的长安东市，听到摊主的笑话，转头看向同伴；眼角先弯起，笑容尚未完全绽开。发型为唐式翻绾髻，搭配孔雀蓝锦缎内层、朱砂红半臂上衣、古金珠纹和雾紫色披帛。采用 35mm 彩色街头摄影；朱红灯笼、青绿酒旗、香料摊和人群形成密集色彩层次，边缘允许路人和灯笼自然遮挡。

第二张照片：“曲池舟上的短暂停顿”：
人物坐在宫苑中小型彩绘游船船头，低头被船边跃起的锦鲤吸引。发型为侧偏唐式堕马髻，饰以白玉梳和浅金花簪。服装使用珍珠白、浅青、淡粉和水绿色丝绸。采用 80mm 中画幅风格的自然压缩感，让浅青水面、粉白宫墙倒影、船身和石桥形成柔和的几何关系，环境中保留大面积负空间以保持安静午后氛围。

第三张照片：“蹴鞠中在球过线前救球”：
人物刚刚用膝盖救起蹴鞠，身体略微失衡，目光追着球，正大笑出声。头发束成紧致高垂髻，穿绯红内层、青绿短外袍、古金腰带和深色分裙裤。采用 24mm 近距离广角、低腰机位、轻微上仰和倾斜构图。蹴鞠球与膝盖形成适度透视效果；手臂和手被裁出画面。低功率日间补光闪光仅增强眼睛和织物的清晰度。

第四张照片：“曲江春宴上的抬头”：
人物坐在曲水宴席边缘，听到画外友人叫她，从果盘方向抬起眼睛。发型为向上扩展的唐式抛家髻，饰以金叶片步摇、白玉花簪和短珍珠链。服装使用胭脂红内层、珍珠白大袖袍、石绿高腰织带和浅杏色披帛。采用略高机位、80mm 中长焦与深景深，同时保留主角、同伴、织席、游船、乐队和曲水之间的关系。背景人物表现为分享水果、交谈、听乐或看水。

光线：
所有人物面部使用宽广连续的自然光或真实店铺光。水面、灯笼和树影只应影响背景和服装边缘，不得在额头、鼻子、脸颊或嘴唇上产生破碎光斑、白色圆形光点或色彩污染。

质感：
四张照片分别呈现密集彩色街头摄影、柔和空间几何、近距离广角补光闪光和高角度社交场景摄影。色彩清晰但不过度饱和，保留真实颗粒、轻微倾斜、边缘裁切和瞬时运动感。人物美丽但不要呈现塑料感 AI 脸；不要黑白或统一滤镜。右下角添加低调的小型手写签名“Zhong”。

生成高端流行偶像排版封面海报。

主题：{argument name="主题" default="音乐封面/偶像视觉/流行社论/活动概念"}

主标题：{argument name="主标题" default="[填写主标题]"}
副标题：[填写短副标题]
版本小文字：[填写期号/版本/次要信息]

国家设置：[中国/韩国/日本/泰国/法国/美国/巴西/阿根廷/英国等]
氛围：[大胆/时尚/情感/动感/青春/图形/社论]
颜色系统：[红/白/黑/深红/柔白]

整体效果应类似于高端流行音乐视觉封面或时尚杂志海报。

使用超大字体作为视觉结构的一部分，而不仅仅是简单的标题。

通过以下方式允许主题和文本之间进行显着交互：遮挡、交织、裁剪、透视、空间分层、部分模糊和前景/背景关系。

布局应该干净且有影响力，仅保留少量辅助文本。

选择以下四个方向之一：

1.动态红色字体封面
使用白色或灰白色背景和超大粗体红色文本。以充满活力的姿势呈现成年年轻女性或男性偶像，与文字强烈互动。

2.红色背景聚焦肖像封面
使用浓郁的红色背景和偶像的特写或半身肖像。包括优雅的白色衬线文本，在眼睛上方有一个微妙的焦点框；梦幻般的氛围和清澈的眼睛。

3.动态偶像舞台海报
使用强烈的表演姿势和夸张的视角（例如，腿、靴子或手臂靠近镜头）。大文本被正文部分切割，营造出舞台视觉或音乐会海报的感觉。

4. 耳机流行社论封面
在特写或半身镜头中展示戴着耳机的偶像。结合与主体轮廓互动的高垂直文本，搭配 1-2 个小标签文本框，打造时尚、不拥挤的外观。

避免：廉价的模板感觉、过多的小文本、杂乱的构图、弱字体、假冒品牌徽标、变形的肢体、不正确的手指、塑料皮肤或堆积的贴纸元素。

要求：大胆、干净、现代、以设计为导向。仅生成一张高质量的独立海报。

2. 一颗咖啡种子裂开，一条弯曲的绿色芽从黑暗的土壤中向上长出，说明文字：“第一颗芽破土而出。”
3. 一棵咖啡幼苗，长着两片新鲜的绿叶，土壤中可见细细的浅色根，说明文字：“新生命在黑暗中生长。”
4. 较高的绿色咖啡豆芽，两侧是两半棕色的种子，说明文字：“种子变形，自然塑造。”
5. 黑暗中，一颗光滑的绿色咖啡樱桃挂在一根细细的树枝上，下面有一个小水滴，说明文字：“樱桃在沉默中成熟。”
6. 左下面板，左上标签为“6 5.0 - 6.0s”；展示了一颗成熟的红色咖啡樱桃裂开，露出里面一颗浅色的咖啡豆，从深色的土壤中生长出来，说明文字：“咖啡豆诞生了，浓郁而完整。”
7. 左上角标签“7 6.0 - 7.0s”；显示单个烘焙咖啡豆漂浮或隔离在黑色的背景下，非常接近的宏观细节，标题：“从大自然的工作到收获。”
8. 左上角标签“8 7.0 - 8.0s”；展示精细研磨的咖啡从研磨机落入手握的手柄中，标题：“研磨至完美。”
9. 左上角标签“9 8.0 - 9.0s”；显示浓缩咖啡的提取过程，两股细流从手柄中倒入下面的深色杯子中，标题：“精确提取。”
10. 左上角标签“10 9.0 - 10.0s”；展示了一名咖啡师将金属水罐中的热牛奶倒入一杯浓缩咖啡中，形成干净的拿铁艺术，说明文字：“精心打造，完美和谐。”

文本自定义：使用 {argument name="brand Mood" default="premium Cinematic Coffee Commercial"} 样式。主要的标题语气应该是诗意的和简约的。 （可选）将最终标题替换为 {argument name="final Caption" default="Crafted into a Perfect Harmony."}，同时保留相同的位置。

视觉限制：仅保留 10 个面板，每行恰好 5 个面板，并且仅在面板 6 到 10 上保留编号的计时标签。请勿添加徽标、水印、额外的图标、额外的面板、装饰性边框或不相关的文本。保持真实的咖啡质感、暗土颗粒、深邃的黑色、温暖的高光以及奢华的商业氛围。

Layout: Top row contains panels 1–5 with centered white caption text near the lower third but no visible numbers. Bottom row contains panels 6–10 with small white timing labels at the top left of each panel and centered white caption text near the bottom. items.promptZh:
目标：为一段短动画奇幻场景创建一张精致的电影感故事板，该场景讲述 {argument name="character name" default="a tiny dragon"} 发现一种意想不到的魔法能力。

画布：宽幅16:9故事板，八个面板以整洁的4×2网格排列。每个面板上方为生动图像区，下方为黑色说明文字条。面板之间使用细黑分隔线。整体观感：高端3D动画家庭电影风格，温暖森林光照，浅景深，富有表现力的角色表演，发光粒子，繁茂花朵，苔藓，蝴蝶和柔和的金色阳光光束。

主角细节：主角是一只可爱的小橙色幼龙，有奶油色腹部、大大的绿色眼睛、小角、小蝙蝠翅膀、圆润的口鼻、柔软鳞片和孩童般的比例。故事发生在一片魔法林地空地，那里满是花朵、覆苔石头、萤火虫般的闪光和友好的动物。小龙试图喷火，却反而创造出 {argument name="magical breath effect" default="rainbow flame"}。

布局与精确面板数量：使用恰好8个故事板面板，编号1到8，并包含以下可见说明文字和动作：

面板1说明文字：“1. (0–2s) Establishing Shot”，副说明文字：“A tiny dragon stands alone, looking determined.” 图像：宽幅建立镜头，小龙站在发光魔法空地的森林小路上，周围有蝴蝶和花朵。

面板2说明文字：“2. (2–4s) Determination”，副说明文字：“The dragon puffs its cheeks, takes a huge breath, and spreads its wings.” 图像：中近景，小龙紧闭双眼、鼓起脸颊、张开翅膀，戏剧性地做准备。

面板3说明文字：“3. (4–6s) Failure”，副说明文字：“It exhales with all its strength… but only a tiny puff of smoke comes out.” 图像：特写，一只眨着的眼睛和噘起的嘴释放出一小团灰色烟雾。

面板4说明文字：“4. (6–8s) Embarrassment”，副说明文字：“The dragon feels shy while a bird tilts its head, watching curiously.” 图像：小龙不好意思地挠头，一只可爱的蓝色小鸟停在附近的树枝上。

面板5说明文字：“5. (8–10s) The Sneeze”，副说明文字：“The smoke tickles its nose. It builds up… and prepares for the biggest sneeze ever!” 图像：小龙面部极度特写，眼睛睁大，鼻孔周围有烟雾旋涡，正要打喷嚏。

面板6说明文字：“6. (10–12s) Magical Surprise”，副说明文字：“It sneezes! Instead of fire, a HUGE burst of rainbow flames explodes out!” 图像：侧视图，小龙打喷嚏喷出巨大的闪耀彩虹冲击波，明亮饱和的色彩，闪烁余烬。

面板7说明文字：“7. (12–14s) Wonder”，副说明文字：“Animals stare in amazement as the rainbow flames light up the whole forest.” 图像：更宽的镜头，小龙位于中央，周围恰好有5只可见的林地动物敬畏地观看：兔子、松鼠、小鹿般的幼鹿、刺猬和一只小鸟。彩虹火焰在它们上方穿过树木形成弧线。

面板8说明文字：“8. (14–15s) Happy Ending”，副说明文字：“The dragon laughs with joy as a tiny rainbow flame dances above its nose. Everyone celebrates!” 图像：欢乐的特写，小龙张嘴大笑，眼睛闪耀，小小彩虹火焰在鼻子上方卷曲，欢呼的森林动物在背景中虚化。

视觉风格：电影感3D动画，类似皮克斯的可爱角色魅力，精细鳞片和柔软皮肤质感，温暖橙金色光照，魔法彩虹光辉，体积阳光光束，散景，富有表现力的面部，高制作价值，适合家庭的基调。

文字约束：所有说明文字保持英文原文准确不变。在每个黑色说明文字条上使用干净的白色无衬线字体居中显示。保持可读性。不要添加额外面板、徽标、水印、UI元素或无关文字。

items.promptZh:
# 参考和目的
- 附上一张用户拥有的{argument name="reference" default="全身女性参考图片"}。
- 仅将参考图像应用于{argument name="subject" default="Princess"}，而不应用于将军。
- 创建一张1:1的方形人物表，适合分享和视频制作参考。
- 平衡视觉吸引力与识别人员、服装和武器的实用性。
- 没有故事板；没有对城堡或王座等背景的描述。

# 参考主题的继承
从参考图像继承公主的面部特征、眼睛、脸型、鼻子/嘴巴、发型、颜色、刘海、分型、长度、年龄、皮肤、身高、比例和体型。在所有视图中保持同一性，而不会过度美化或老化。不要从参考中继承服装、配色方案或背景。

# 表达式
- 相当于剧场动画的细腻线条，高品质的卡通渲染，以及金属、布料和宝石的精致纹理。
- 精致的表面处理相当于官方画册。
- 避免 3D、现实或廉价的电视动画风格。

# 固定角色设计
## 公主
- 苗条优雅的皇家击剑手。
- 珍珠白高级战斗服，避免过度暴露。
- 镀铬银肩甲/臂甲/腰甲。不要用金属覆盖整个胸部。
- 皇家深红色短分体战袍和长腰带。
- 珍珠白色及膝靴，带有深红色/镀铬装饰。
- 香槟金饰边、皇家徽章图案、小祖母绿和细圆环。

## 皇家剑
细长的银色直剑，带有弯曲的金色护手，深绿色的握把，冠柄和深棕色的剑鞘。

## 一般
- 成熟男性，比公主更高更宽，表情严肃棱角分明，黑灰色短发。
- 由黑钢和优质炮铜制成的重型装甲。
- 多层胸甲、宽肩、高领、黄金镶嵌、狮子/猛禽浮雕。
- 黑色天鹅绒斗篷，深绿色衬里，深棕色皮带。

# 布局
1:1 平方。前6%标题，上段56%，下段38%。
背景为白色至浅象牙色。标题：仅限“{argument name="title" default="SWORD PRINCESS"}` 和“CHARACTER REFERENCE”。

## 上半部分
- ‘01 英雄公主’ (45%)：战斗准备姿势的全身 3/4 视图。
- `02 公主正面` (22%)：全身正面图。
- `03 将军战斗` (33%)：将军的全身 3/4 视图。

## 下半部分
- `04 公主脸` (32%)：两个面部视图（正面和 3/4）。
- `05 将军面孔` (16%)：将军的一张面部视图。
- `07 资产指南` (24%)：武器和调色板。
- `06 将军投降` (28%)：将军单膝跪下。
items.prompt:
# Reference and Purpose
- Attach one {argument name="reference" default="full-body female reference image"} owned by the user.

# Inheritance of Reference Subject
Inherit the Princess's facial features, eyes, face shape, nose/mouth, hairstyle, color, bangs, parting, length, age, skin, height, proportions, and body type from the reference image. Maintain identity across all views without excessive beautification or aging. Do not inherit outfit, color scheme, or background from the reference.

# Expression
- Delicate lines equivalent to theatrical anime, high-quality cel shading, and refined texture for metal, cloth, and gems.
- Sophisticated finish equivalent to an official artbook.

# Fixed Character Design
## Princess
- Slender and elegant royal fencer.
- Pearl-white high-grade combat attire, avoiding excessive exposure.

The name is in bold black simplified Chinese, and the bio is in smaller dark gray text, left-aligned in up to two lines, with no typos or garbled characters. Items like the silk pouch, poem manuscripts, old handkerchief, brush, medicine bottle, and bamboo-leaf sachet are displayed independently, with color swatches of smoky blue, moon white, lotus root, bamboo green, and ink gray, along with samples of silk, satin, Xuan paper, and white porcelain. items.promptZh:
主题：门廊上的凉爽夏日时光

主要拍摄对象：一位 20 多岁的女性坐在明亮的夏日缘川门廊上，脸上挂着透明的弹珠汽水瓶，微笑着。她周围有几个赤壁风格的小角色，有着相同的发型和服装，每个角色都有不同的动作，比如拿着扇子、指指点点、画画或拥抱。左上角挂着一个玻璃风铃，右下角有一个带有圆形花扇的金鱼缸。

性格/表情：看着镜头时脸稍微向左，带着温柔、友好的微笑。柔和的鹅蛋脸，杏仁形的浅棕色眼睛，自然的细眉毛。她的棕色长发是半高高的发型，有细刘海和小{argument name="hair饰品"default="浅蓝色花朵装饰"}。

服装/姿势：{argument name="top color" default="light blue"} V 领蕾丝风格无袖针织上衣，搭配白色喇叭长裙。她用右手握住瓶子，用左手支撑在地板上。

背景/灯光：{argument name="background" default="traditional wood house porch"}，带有打开的障子门和生机勃勃的绿色花园。来自左上角的柔和自然光在皮肤、头发和地板上产生温暖的斑纹。

构图/相机：垂直 3:4 宽高比。膝盖以上的全身肖像，以人物为中心。 《赤壁》角色有节奏地散布在她周围。浅景深。

纹理/风格：主要人物和门廊的高清真实感表达。小角色被渲染为精致的 3D 赤壁模型。白色、粉色和黄色的手绘线条艺术上覆盖着心形、太阳等涂鸦，以及“夏天”和“快乐”等文字。

负面：不要将主体和赤壁的面孔混在一起；保持手/瓶子自然握持；不要忽略风铃或金鱼缸。

将成年女性与各种街机之间的自然互动捕捉为一系列千禧年以来真实的 MiniDV 家庭视频帧。 

常用设置：
{argument name="videotexture"default="垂直肖像，清晰的成人原始女性，真实的街机环境。MiniDV家庭视频质量，轻微的隔行扫描线，渗色，暗噪声，运动模糊，以及时间戳/录制感觉。"}角色保留自然的皮肤纹理和轻微的不对称，避免过度的皮肤平滑或商业模特姿势。拱廊灯用作环境照明，顶部安装的柔和补光灯照亮脸部；禁止随机光点覆盖面部特征。

框架 1：
关门后夹娃娃机过道狭窄。从左上方轻微高角度拍摄；这位女士刚刚完成补货，正用一只手关上玻璃门，身体沿着机器形成对角线，同时回头看着镜头。闪亮的粉白色常服，不透明低领，束腰裙，长筒袜。冷白色橱柜灯和黑​​暗走廊阴影之间的对比。

框架2：
老式舞蹈机平台。从腰部高度侧向射击；女人刚刚打完最后一个节拍，双脚稳稳地踩在两个踏板上，身体还在轻微的运动，马尾辫和裙子保持着惯性。银蓝色舞台制服，街机屏幕和踏板灯反射出蓝紫色；模糊仅出现在发尖和背景上。

第 3 帧：

{argument name="负面提示" default="未成年感、娃娃脸、皮肤过度平滑、塑料皮肤、随机面部光点、完美的商业广告、现代高清电影外观、浮动人物、设备和身体之间的剪辑、变形的方向盘、错误的踏板位置、不自然放大的前景肢体、多余的手指、重复的肢体、乱码文字、真实的品牌徽标、水印。"}

Capture natural interactions between an adult woman and various arcade machines as a series of authentic MiniDV home video frames from around the millennium. 

Common Settings:
{argument name="video texture" default="Vertical portrait, clearly adult original female, authentic arcade environment. MiniDV home video quality, slight interlaced scan lines, color bleeding, dark noise, motion blur, and a timestamp/recording feel."} Characters preserve natural skin texture and slight asymmetries, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or commercial model posing. Arcade lights serve as ambient lighting, with soft top-mounted fill light illuminating the face; random light spots covering facial features are prohibited.

Narrow claw machine aisle after closing. Slight high-angle shot from the top left; the woman has just finished restocking and is closing the glass door with one hand, body forming a diagonal line along the machine as she looks back at the camera. Old-school dance machine platform. Side-tracking shot from waist height; the woman has just finished the last beat, feet landed stably on two pedals, body still in slight motion with ponytail and skirt retaining inertia. Silver-blue stage uniform, with blue-purple reflections from the arcade screen and pedal lights; blur only appears on hair tips and background.

Frame 3:
Red and black racing simulator cockpit. Low-angle close-up from the side-front of the dashboard; the woman leans back naturally into the bucket seat after the race, shoulders relaxed, turning to look at the camera. Red and black racing-style uniform, with clear wheel, gauge, and seat structures; accurate physical interaction between body and equipment without clipping.

Frame 4:
Inside a pink photo booth. Camera near the outer curtain; the woman peeks her upper body out from between two pink plastic curtains, as if checking for friends after a photo. Black and white lace uniform, hands hidden behind curtains, focus on eyes, slightly parted lips, and close-range flash lighting.

items.prompt: A cinematic, highly detailed scene of a {argument name="subject" default="27-year-old man with a smart, lean physique, soft brown hair, and a shy, innocent expression"}. He is dressed in simple corporate office attire, reflecting the routine of a monotonous 9-to-5 office life. He stands quietly at a {argument name="location" default="crowded city bus stop"} during the evening rush hour, surrounded by dozens of commuters who seem distant and emotionless. The entire world is shown in black and white, emphasizing the dullness and repetition of his daily life. Dark clouds gather overhead, and rain suddenly begins to pour. While everyone around him rushes to open umbrellas or seek shelter, he simply lowers his gaze, accepting the rain in silence. At that moment, a {argument name="stranger" default="25-year-old woman with fair skin, an elegant appearance, and a warm, genuine smile"} steps beside him. She gently extends her umbrella to cover both of them. As he looks up and their eyes meet, they exchange a quiet, heartfelt smile. The instant their eyes meet, the black-and-white world begins transforming into vibrant color. The rain glows softly, the city lights become warm and vivid, and every detail around them comes to life. The crowd remains in the background, blurred and insignificant, while the two stand beneath the umbrella, sharing a silent, magical connection. The scene is emotional, romantic, and hopeful, symbolizing how a single act of kindness can bring color into someone’s life.

对象详细信息：一名年轻的东亚女性，{argument name="hair style" default="深棕色头发，松散的盘发，搭配纤细的刘海和修饰脸型的发丝"}，自然明亮的妆容，光泽的嘴唇，精致的吊式耳环，以及泰然自若的过肩姿势。她带着平静自信的表情直视观众。她的肩膀和上背部清晰可见。她穿着一件闪闪发光的粉红色薄纱高级定制连衣裙，无肩带紧身胸衣，闪闪发光的质地，透明的分层荷叶边和精致的手镯。皮肤应该看起来精致且具有编辑性但又真实。

杂志标识和版式：最顶部的大报头以巨大优雅的高对比度衬线字母阅读{argument name =“magazine title”default =“EMA'S”}，淡粉色，几乎覆盖整个宽度。左侧刊头下方有小写的大写文字：“时尚 | 美容 | 生活方式”。右上角是小写的问题文本：{argument name="issue text" default="AUGUST 2025\nISSUE 48"}。使用精致的时尚杂志排版组合：高衬线标题、斜体衬线重音、干净的无衬线正文副本和大型手写脚本功能线。

布局和文本内容：包括 8 个封面文本组和 1 个条形码块：
1. 顶部刊头：“EMA'S”。
2. 小品类线：“时尚|美容|生活方式”。
3. 发行信息：“2025年8月”和“ISSUE 48”。
4. 左上特征：标题“NEW\nSEASON\nGLOW”，正文“毫不费力的美丽\n看起来会带你度过\n每一个时刻。”和一条短而细的分隔线。
5. 左中特征：斜体标题“Mind.\nBody.\nBalance”。正文为“健康仪式\n让你更平静、\n更强大。”和一条短而细的分隔线。
6. 右上特征：斜体标题“Be\nYou”，正文“Confidence\nis the best\naccessory”。和一条短而细的分隔线。
7. 右中圆形徽章：浅粉色轮廓的细圆圈，包含“独家\n采访”和较小的文字“鼓舞人心\n对话。\n真实故事。”
8. 右下方特征：标题“时尚\n预测”，正文“主要趋势、\n新鲜主打、\n永恒风格”。和一条短而细的分隔线。
9. 底部主封面线：巨大的白色手写脚本，上面写着{argument name="main cover line" default="Made to Shine"}，与下半身着装区域重叠，下面有小的大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="EMBRACE YOUR STORY. OWN YOUR POWER."}
10. 左下条形码块：带有黑条的白色小条形码矩形，上面有微小的价格文本，例如“$6.99 US $8.99 CAN”，以及小的数字详细信息。

视觉风格：逼真的时尚编辑封面，温暖的对比，头发和肩膀上柔和的边缘光，优雅的粉白色版式，奢华的美容杂志美学，干净的专业间距。保持模特居中稍偏右，脸部位于中上，报头位于头后/上方，大脚本标题位于底部。

限制：没有额外的徽标或水印。使所有文本清晰易读。保留列出的文本组的准确数量和位置。不要在指定的封面行之外添加其他标题。

items.promptZh: 一幅超现实的特写肖像，描绘了一位优雅的年轻女子在一艘豪华游艇上巡航穿过原始热带泻湖，享受阳光明媚的下午。从四分之三的后方角度拍摄她，她的身体背对着镜头，回头望去，脸上挂着轻松、灿烂的微笑。她拥有完美无瑕的白皙肌肤、柔和雕刻的鹅蛋脸、富有表现力的黑眉毛、精致的五官、自然红润的嘴唇和明亮的皮肤。栗棕色的长发在海风中自由地飘扬。她穿着时尚的黑色无袖上衣，搭配复古风格的椭圆形太阳镜，配有细长的金色镜框和简约的玫瑰金腕表。在她身后，碧波荡漾的海水一直延伸到地平线，蓝天白云高耸，营造出田园诗般的奢华旅行氛围。温暖的自然阳光增强了丰富的海洋色彩和微妙的肤色。浅景深、优质旅行编辑风格、逼真的皮肤细节、清爽的发丝、HDR 摄影、电影般的真实感、旗舰智能手机相机质量、超细致的 8K。
items.prompt: An ultra-realistic close-up portrait of an elegant young woman enjoying a sunny afternoon aboard a luxury yacht cruising across a pristine tropical lagoon. She is captured from a three-quarter rear angle, her body turned away from the camera as she glances back with a relaxed, radiant smile. She has flawless fair skin, a softly sculpted oval face, expressive dark eyebrows, delicate facial features, naturally rosy lips, and luminous skin. Her long chestnut-brown wavy hair flows freely in the ocean breeze. She is dressed in a sleek black sleeveless top, accessorized with vintage-inspired oval sunglasses featuring a slim gold frame and a minimalist rose-gold wristwatch. Behind her, sparkling turquoise water stretches to the horizon beneath a vivid blue sky filled with towering white clouds, creating an idyllic luxury travel atmosphere. Warm natural sunlight enhances the rich ocean colors and subtle skin tones. Shallow depth of field, premium travel editorial style, lifelike skin detail, crisp hair strands, HDR photography, cinematic realism, flagship smartphone camera quality, ultra-detailed 8K.

items.title: Product Marketing - Victorian Royal Courtyard Fashion Portrait
items.titleZh: 产品营销-维多利亚皇家庭院时尚肖像
items.promptZh: 超现实的全身时尚肖像，描绘了一位优雅的年轻女子在阳光明媚的春天下午站在郁郁葱葱的皇家庭院中。她有一头栗棕色的长发，扎成{argument name="hair style" default="双发髻，精致的珍珠花"}，富有表情的{argument name="eye color" default="emerald-green"}眼睛，还有温暖、自然的微笑。她穿着一件设计精美的{argument name="dress color" default="sapphire-blue and ivory"}维多利亚风格连衣裙，配有分层荷叶边、刺绣蕾丝、泡泡袖、合身紧身胸衣和装饰性腰带，搭配清爽的白色围裙。她的服装搭配白色过膝长袜，饰有缎带和经典的白色高跟鞋。她优雅地站在鹅卵石花园小路上，周围环绕着盛开的绣球花、玫瑰和攀缘花，远处矗立着一座迷人的宫殿。柔和的金色阳光透过树林，创造出电影般的亮点和柔和的阴影。具有自然毛孔的超真实感皮肤、逼真的面部细节、真实的纹理、浅景深、优质编辑摄影、HDR，使用 85 毫米全画幅相机拍摄，令人惊叹的真实感、超高细节、8K。
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic full-body fashion portrait of an elegant young woman standing in a lush royal courtyard during a bright spring afternoon. She has long chestnut-brown hair styled into {argument name="hair style" default="twin buns adorned with delicate pearl blossoms"}, expressive {argument name="eye color" default="emerald-green"} eyes, and a warm, natural smile. She wears an intricately designed {argument name="dress color" default="sapphire-blue and ivory"} Victorian-inspired dress featuring layered ruffles, embroidered lace, puffed sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a decorative waist ribbon, complemented by a crisp white apron. Her outfit is completed with white over-the-knee stockings accented by satin ribbons and classic white heels. She stands gracefully along a cobblestone garden path surrounded by blooming hydrangeas, roses, and climbing flowers, with an enchanting palace rising in the distance. Soft golden sunlight filters through the trees, creating cinematic highlights and gentle shadows. Ultra-photorealistic skin with natural pores, lifelike facial details, authentic textures, shallow depth of field, premium editorial photography, HDR, captured on an 85mm full-frame camera, breathtaking realism, ultra-high detail, 8K.
items.author: Meem

items.title: 冰鲸夏日汽水广告
items.promptZh: 创建一个垂直的、超现实的夏季奇幻饮料广告场景：一个高大的透明玻璃杯的极端特写，里面装满了闪闪发光的翠绿苏打水、碎冰、气泡、冷凝水滴和光滑的石灰状亮点，坐在明亮的沙滩上。饮料中升起一个微型冰冷的北极世界：一头半透明的蓝色冰鲸从苏打水中戏剧性地冲出，它的头和身体向上呈弧形，水花和水滴冻结在半空中，身体上有细小的发光冰脊。旁边，浮在水面上的一个圆形的白色冰雪堆上，正好放置着四只北极小动物：三只企鹅直立成一排，一只白色北极熊站在它们的右边。这些动物应该看起来像精致的霜冻冰雕，具有微妙的现实细节。背景：碧绿的海洋，模糊的海滩游客，遥远的低山，生动无云的蓝天，右边有柔软的白云，左上方强烈的夏日阳光和镜头光晕。使用明亮清爽的色彩、闪闪发光的高光、浅景深、微距摄影视角、热带炎热与冰冷之间的高对比度、电影般的真实感、无文字、无徽标、无水印。将饮料自定义为 {argument name="drink color" default="emerald green"}，将主要冰冷生物自定义为 {argument name="ice Bio" default="breaching blue shark"}，将北极动物群自定义为 {argument name="animal group" default="三只企鹅和一只北极熊"}，将设置自定义为 {argument name="beach setting" default="sunnytropical beach"}，将灯光氛围自定义为 {argument name="lighting Mood"默认=“带有镜头光晕的灿烂正午阳光”}。
items.prompt: Create a vertical, hyperrealistic summer fantasy beverage advertisement scene: an extreme close-up of a tall transparent glass filled with sparkling emerald-green soda, crushed ice, bubbles, condensation droplets, and glossy lime-like highlights, sitting on a bright sandy beach. From the drink rises a miniature icy arctic world: one translucent blue ice whale breaching dramatically from the soda with its head and body arcing upward, water splashes and droplets frozen midair, and fine glowing ice ridges along its body. Beside it, on a rounded white snow-and-ice mound floating at the surface, place exactly four small arctic animals: three penguins standing upright in a row, and one white polar bear standing to their right. The animals should look like delicate frosty ice sculptures with subtle realistic detail. Background: turquoise ocean, blurred beachgoers, distant low mountains, a vivid cloudless blue sky with a soft white cloud on the right, and intense summer sun rays and lens flare from the upper left. Use bright refreshing colors, sparkling highlights, shallow depth of field, macro photography perspective, high contrast between tropical heat and icy coolness, cinematic realism, no text, no logo, no watermark. Customize the drink as {argument name="drink color" default="emerald green"}, the main icy creature as {argument name="ice creature" default="breaching blue whale"}, the arctic animal group as {argument name="animal group" default="three penguins and one polar bear"}, the setting as {argument name="beach setting" default="sunny tropical beach"}, and the lighting mood as {argument name="lighting mood" default="brilliant midday sun with lens flare"}.

items.title: 低角度产品广告大片
items.promptZh:
使用下载的产品图片作为准确的参考。充分保留形状、包装、材质、颜色、比例、标志、品牌元素。
超写实的商业广告海报。 {argument name="view" default="低角度广角镜头视图"}。自信、时尚的模特拿着产品，直接面对镜头。由于强制透视效果，该产品在前景中占据主导地位。
现代时尚形象，服装、配饰和调色板自动适应产品的风格和颜色。动感能量、优质品牌美学、时尚生活内容。
一款细节丰富的产品，具有逼真的纹理、倒影、水滴和清晰易读的包装。背景充满了{argument name="background elements" default="品牌颜色的图形元素：涂鸦、笔触、油漆泼溅、拼贴纹理、箭头、星星、闪电、贴纸和广告排版"}。
图像中的所有文本必须以 {argument name="language" default="Russian"} 书写，完全清晰、语法正确，没有拼写错误、随机符号、扭曲的字母、不可读的单词或 AI 伪影。所有的标题、口号、描述、风味、特征和广告短语都应该看起来像真正的专业广告。
人工智能会自动调整字体、大小、构图和文本位置以适应海报布局。
高级杂志设计、高对比度、锐焦、商业产品摄影、豪华广告、时尚社论、超写实、照片写实、HDR、8K。
避免：不可读的文本、俄语错误、人工智能伪影、CGI、卡通风格、扭曲的产品、模糊、水印和低质量。
items.prompt:
Use the downloaded product image as an exact reference. Fully preserve the shape, packaging, materials, colors, proportions, logo, and brand elements.
An ultra-realistic commercial advertising poster. A {argument name="view" default="low-angle wide-angle lens view"}. A confident, stylish model holding the product, directly facing the camera. The product dominates the foreground due to the forced perspective effect.
A modern fashion image, with clothing, accessories, and color palette automatically adapting to the product's style and colors. Dynamic energy, premium brand aesthetics, trendy lifestyle content.
A highly detailed product with realistic textures, reflections, water droplets, and perfectly legible packaging. The background is filled with {argument name="background elements" default="graphic elements in the brand's colors: graffiti, brush strokes, paint splashes, collage textures, arrows, stars, lightning bolts, stickers, and advertising typography"}.
All text in the image must be written in {argument name="language" default="Russian"}, fully legible, grammatically correct, without spelling errors, random symbols, distorted letters, unreadable words, or AI artifacts. All headlines, slogans, descriptions, flavors, characteristics, and advertising phrases should look like a real professional advertisement.
The AI automatically adapts fonts, sizes, composition, and text placement to the poster layout.
Premium magazine design, high contrast, sharp focus, commercial product photography, luxury advertising, fashion editorial, ultra realistic, photorealistic, HDR, 8K.
Avoid: unreadable text, errors in Russian, AI artifacts, CGI, cartoonish style, distorted product, blurriness, watermarks, and low quality.

items.title: 美妆产品特写广告
items.promptZh: 使用上传的模特照片作为准确的个性参考。 1:1 保持外观：脸部、五官、比例、皮肤、头发和整体外观。不要改变性格。皮肤必须最大限度地自然和有活力：真实的毛孔、自然的纹理、柔和的自然光泽、没有整形修饰、没有美化、没有过度平滑。使用上传的产品照片作为准确的产品参考。 1:1 保留产品：形状、尺寸、比例、包装、盖子、标签、徽标、文本、材料、颜色、涂层、反射和所有设计细节。产品必须看起来非常自然和逼真，就像手中的真实物体一样，而不是计算机生成的，没有扭曲，也没有重新解释。以{argument name="campaign style" default="modern奢华化妆品campaign"}风格拍摄的特写美女。照片参考中的模特将上传照片中的产品放在一只眼睛附近，稍微遮住它，并做出{argument name="facial expression" default="俏皮的面部表情，柔软的嘴唇，亲吻脸风格"}。目光直视相机。头发顺利地向后梳。戴在耳朵上 — {argument name="accessories" default="金环耳环"}。背景——干净简约的白色，没有多余的物体。工作室灯光柔和，干净的美感灯光，皮肤和产品上有精致的亮点。妆容自然清新：容光焕发的皮肤，微微闪亮的嘴唇，整齐的眉毛，柔和强调的眼睛，没有浓妆。整体审美——新鲜的护肤/美容社论，有光泽，昂贵，现代，但同时自然和现实。框架焦点 — 模特的脸部、自然皮肤和产品。避免：改变脸部、塑料皮肤、大量修饰、CGI 产品外观、难以辨认的徽标、额外的物体、不良的手部解剖结构、卡通化。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded model photo as an exact personality reference. Preserve appearance 1:1: face, features, proportions, skin, hair, and overall look. Do not change the personality. The skin must be maximally natural and alive: real pores, natural texture, soft natural glow, no plastic retouching, no beautify, no excessive smoothing. Use the uploaded product photo as an exact product reference. Preserve the product 1:1: shape, size, proportions, packaging, cap, label, logo, text, material, color, coating, reflections, and all design details. The product must look maximally natural and realistic, like a real physical object in hand, not CGI, without distortions and without reinterpretation. Close-up beauty shot in the style of a {argument name="campaign style" default="modern luxury cosmetic campaign"}. The model from the photo reference holds the product from the uploaded photo near one eye, slightly covering it, and makes a {argument name="facial expression" default="playful facial expression with soft lips in a kissy face style"}. Gaze is directed at the camera. Hair is smoothly combed back. On the ears — {argument name="accessories" default="gold hoop earrings"}. Background — clean minimalist white, without extra objects. Lighting is soft studio, clean beauty lighting, with delicate highlights on skin and product. Makeup is natural and fresh: glowing skin, slightly shiny lips, neat eyebrows, softly emphasized eyes, no heavy makeup. Overall aesthetic — fresh skincare / beauty editorial, glossy, expensive, modern, but at the same time natural and realistic. Frame focus — on the model's face, natural skin, and product. Avoid: changing the face, plastic skin, heavy retouching, CGI product look, unreadable logo, extra objects, bad hand anatomy, cartoonishness.
items.author: H A J R A

items.title: 极简护肤品质感静物
items.promptZh: 在 4:3 的水平画布上创建逼真的奢华护肤品静物画。准确展示 3 个站在透明亚克力块上的未贴标签的化妆品容器：左侧 1 个圆肩形状的高哑光乳白色乳液瓶和半透明白色翻盖，1 个透明淡蓝色圆柱形瓶子，装满透明液体，中间有缎面银色瓶盖，右侧 1 个淡薰衣草粉色泵瓶，带有白色泵分配器。将它们紧密地排列在一起，稍微向右居中，中间的蓝色瓶子比白色瓶子稍短，泵瓶比蓝色瓶子稍高。亚克力底座应为矩形、有光泽、透明，并沿正面和顶面覆盖有可见的水滴。使用凉爽的雾气水疗氛围：磨砂玻璃背景，带有垂直凝结条纹，许多微小的水滴，柔和的蓝灰色和白色渐变照明，以及在底座周围漂浮的低淡紫色雾气。照明应该是高调的、漫射的、透过湿玻璃的背光、柔和的反射和柔和的光晕。没有可读的标签，没有品牌，没有人，没有文字，没有额外的产品。强调清洁保湿、清新、露水凝结和优质化妆品广告摄影。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury skincare product still life on a 4:3 horizontal canvas. Show exactly 3 unlabeled cosmetic containers standing on a clear acrylic block: 1 tall matte milky-white lotion bottle with a rounded-shoulder shape and translucent white flip cap on the left, 1 transparent pale-blue cylindrical bottle filled with clear liquid and a satin silver cap in the center, and 1 pale lavender-pink pump bottle with a white pump dispenser on the right. Arrange them tightly grouped, centered slightly to the right, with the center blue bottle a little shorter than the white bottle and the pump bottle slightly taller than the blue bottle. The acrylic pedestal should be rectangular, glossy, transparent, and covered with visible water droplets along the front face and top surface. Use a cool misty spa atmosphere: frosted glass background with vertical condensation streaks, many tiny water droplets, soft blue-gray and white gradient lighting, and low lavender-tinted fog drifting around the base. Lighting should be high-key, diffused, backlit through the wet glass, with soft reflections and gentle bloom. No readable labels, no branding, no people, no text, no extra products. Emphasize clean hydration, freshness, dewy condensation, and premium cosmetic advertising photography.
items.author: KAWAI

items.title: 精灵角色镜子自拍
items.promptZh: 创建一个逼真的垂直智能手机镜子自拍照，让成人幻想精灵角色扮演者坐在最小的米色房间里的灰色地毯上的柔软白色床单上。主题是{argument name="character name" default="an elf princess cosplayer"}，穿着精致的白色垂褶奇幻服装，配有金色链条细节、细臂珠宝、金色腿带和淡蓝色花朵配饰。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="long silver-gray"}双马尾辫、尖尖的精灵耳朵和一顶蓝白花冠。让她坐着，一条膝盖弯曲靠近身体，另一条腿伸向镜子，形成强烈的前景透视，裸露的脚底和脚趾在左下方的前景中很大；另一只脚在底部边缘附近可见。她的脸前拿着一部浅灰色的智能手机，遮住了面部特征，另一只手抚摸着耳朵附近的头发。使用柔和的自然窗户光、柔和的中性色调、浅休闲的室内现实主义、最左边可见的镜子边缘、沿后墙的踢脚板以及略显坦率的角色扮演摄影美学。保持构图亲密但不露骨，具有逼真的皮肤纹理、织物褶皱、地毯细节，并且不添加文字或水印。
items.prompt: Create a realistic vertical smartphone mirror selfie of an adult fantasy elf cosplayer sitting on a soft white sheet on a gray carpet in a minimal beige room. The subject is {argument name="character name" default="an elf princess cosplayer"}, wearing a delicate white draped fantasy outfit with gold chain details, thin arm jewelry, gold leg bands, and pale blue flower accessories. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long silver-gray"} hair styled in twin ponytails, pointed elf ears, and a blue-and-white floral crown. Pose her seated with one knee bent close to the body and the other leg extended toward the mirror, creating strong foreground perspective with the bare sole and toes large in the lower left foreground; the other foot is visible near the bottom edge. She holds a light gray smartphone in front of her face, obscuring facial features, with her other hand touching her hair near the ear. Use soft natural window light, muted neutral tones, shallow casual indoor realism, visible mirror edge at the far left, baseboard along the back wall, and a slightly candid cosplay photography aesthetic. Keep the composition intimate but non-explicit, with realistic skin texture, fabric folds, carpet detail, and no added text or watermark.
items.author: underwood

items.title: 水彩风男士肖像
items.promptZh: 一幅精致的水彩风格肖像，人物为{argument name="subject" default="一个自信、成熟的男人，留着花白短发，胡须整齐的胡子"}和{argument name="accessories" default="黑色矩形眼镜"}。他身穿炭灰色西装外套，内搭黑色纽扣衬衫，若有所思地看着远方，表情平静而专业。该作品以逼真的面部细节为特色，在干净的灰白色背景上融合了温暖的米色、灰色和棕褐色色调的优雅水彩画，营造出精致、现代的编辑美学。使用上传的参考图像进行面部特征和表情对齐以及空间。纵横比 10:21。
items.prompt: A refined watercolor-style portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a confident, mature man with short salt-and-pepper hair, well groomed beard"}, and {argument name="accessories" default="black rectangular eyeglasses"}. He is dressed in a charcoal blazer over a black button-up shirt, looking thoughtfully into the distance with a calm, professional expression. The artwork features realistic facial details blended with elegant watercolor splashes in warm beige, gray, and sepia tones on a clean off-white background, creating a sophisticated, modern editorial aesthetic. Use uploaded reference images for facial features and expression alignment and spactacles if. Aspect ratio 10:21.
items.author: Karlos

items.title: 芭蕾舞室拉伸写真
items.promptZh: 为在明亮的芭蕾舞工作室练习的{argument name="subject" default="a young成年东亚芭蕾舞演员"}制作一张逼真的垂直肖像照片。她以优雅的站立式针伸展姿势展示了她的全身：一只脚足尖或半足尖踩在灰色工作室地板上，另一条腿在她的头旁边笔直向上抬起，一只手将抬起的芭蕾舞鞋举过头顶，另一只手轻轻地放在右侧的木制芭蕾舞杆上。她穿着 {argument name="leotard color" default="a navy blue camisole leotard"}、淡粉色紧身裤和淡粉色芭蕾舞鞋。她的头发整齐地挽成一个光滑的黑色芭蕾发髻，表情平静而专注，目光微微偏向右侧，而不是看着镜头。工作室拥有柔和的自然光、浅米色的墙壁、光滑的灰色地板、背景中水平延伸的木栏杆以及模糊的墙壁标志，上面写着{argument name="studio wall text" default="Madame YUKO Ballet Studio"}，上面有一个小芭蕾舞演员的剪影。采用浅景深，干净的专业摄影，柔和的肤色，柔和的高光，逼真的解剖结构，优美的姿势，宁静的排练气氛。将舞者集中在 9:16 的垂直构图中，没有多余的人物、没有水印，也没有戏剧性的舞台灯光。

items.promptZh: 创建高度逼真的休闲智能手机自拍照，看起来就像在日本城市户外拍摄的真实 Instagram Story 生活方式快照。拍摄对象是一位性格开朗的年轻女性，{argument name="character name" default="unnamed"}，留着{argument name="hair color" default="金色短发，配上柔和的刘海"}，妆容温暖自然，皮肤白皙透亮，戴着小耳环，直视手机摄像头时，脸上挂着温柔的闭嘴微笑。她高举手机，角度稍大，手臂伸向左下前景，营造出自然的自拍扭曲和亲密坦诚的感觉。她穿着一件纯白色圆领 T 恤，塞进浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤中，戴着一条细银项链、一块白色手表或手镯，肩上挎着一个米色帆布手提包。她的另一只手拿着两件可见的物品：一杯冰咖啡，装在一个带有圆顶盖和黑色吸管的透明塑料杯中，以及一个白色塑料购物袋。将场景设置在人行横道附近阳光明媚的人行道上，有城市店面、绿树成荫的行道树、带有温暖室内灯光的咖啡馆露台、瓷砖路面、触觉铺路，以及右侧可见的一辆停放的自行车。背景中包括一些远处的行人，柔和地模糊。使用午后黄金时段的阳光、自然阴影、逼真的皮肤纹理、微妙的镜头畸变、智能手机 HDR 外观、浅但不过分人工的景深以及坦率的日常时尚照片氛围。整体氛围应该是{argument name="overall momo" default="自然、友好、时尚、不做作"}。没有文字叠加，没有水印，没有选美姿势，没有工作室灯光，没有幻想元素。
items.prompt: Create a highly realistic casual smartphone selfie that looks like an authentic Instagram Story lifestyle snap taken outdoors in a Japanese city. The subject is a cheerful young woman, {argument name="character name" default="unnamed"}, with {argument name="hair color" default="short blonde hair with soft face-framing bangs"}, warm natural makeup, clear glowing skin, small hoop earrings, and a gentle closed-mouth smile while looking directly into the phone camera. She is holding the phone high and slightly wide-angle, arm extended toward the lower-left foreground, creating a natural selfie distortion and an intimate candid feel. She wears a plain white crew-neck T-shirt tucked into light blue high-waisted denim shorts, a thin silver necklace, a white watch or bracelet, and carries a beige canvas tote bag over one shoulder. In her other hand she holds exactly 2 visible items: an iced coffee in a clear plastic cup with a domed lid and black straw, and a white plastic shopping bag. Set the scene on a sunny sidewalk near a crosswalk, with urban storefronts, leafy street trees, a cafe terrace with warm interior lights, tiled pavement, tactile paving, and exactly 1 parked bicycle visible on the right side. Include a few distant pedestrians in the background, softly blurred. Use late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight, natural shadows, realistic skin texture, subtle lens distortion, smartphone HDR look, shallow but not overly artificial depth of field, and a candid everyday fashion-photo mood. The overall atmosphere should be {argument name="overall mood" default="natural, friendly, stylish, and unposed"}. No text overlays, no watermark, no beauty-pageant posing, no studio lighting, no fantasy elements.

items.title: 紫光回眸美女人像
items.promptZh:
主题：转入紫光

主要主体：再现面部特征，翻肩，镜头目光接触，右手放在脖子上，超细黑色带子，棕色头发，左边{argument name="left light color" default="blue-violet light"}，右边{argument name="right light color" default="pink light"}。一幅 20 多岁女性垂直方向的逼真美女肖像，在黑暗的工作室中从肩膀到头顶非常接近地拍摄，具有纯色{argument name="background color" default="purple background"}。该人背朝右侧，将脸转向左肩对着镜头。前景中的大圆形左肩。

性格/表情：椭圆形脸，光滑的下巴，小鼻子，玫瑰米色的嘴唇。头大约转动了40度，深褐色的眼睛直视着镜头。表情安静，嘴唇微微张开。皮肤呈明亮的中性象牙色，鼻子、颧骨和肩膀上有亮点。头发是中棕色的，有薄刘海。

服装/姿势：黑色缎面或哑光弹力吊带背心，配有单条超细肩带。该人扭转上半身，使左肩靠近镜头。她的右手摸到了脖子的右侧。 

背景/灯光：背景从淡紫色过渡到中紫色再到深红紫色。主光从右前方射出，呈柔和的粉红色至红紫色。辅助光是从左前方射出的冷青蓝色到蓝紫色。头发上有洋红色的边缘光。

构图/摄影机：垂直 3:4 紧密特写。相机处于视线水平。中长焦镜头视角。严格关注前景的眼睛、鼻子和嘴唇。

纹理/风格：高分辨率真实感工作室美容摄影。细致的毛孔、发丝和平滑的光线渐变。眼睛里的聚光灯小而自然。

负面：不改双灯光或紫色背景；避免多余的手指/四肢；没有文字、徽标或水印。

items.title: 斑驳光影长椅人像
items.promptZh:
主题：斑驳阳光下的长凳

主要拍摄对象：一张明亮的肖像，照片中一位 20 多岁的女性坐在{argument name="background" default="lush green park"}的深色木凳上，从头到交叉的膝盖垂直拍摄。主体占据了中心框架的大部分。她面朝前方，头稍微向左倾斜，双手撑在长椅上。她的右腿交叉在左腿上，形成一种柔软的坐姿。

性格/表情：小椭圆形脸、浅象牙色皮肤、棕色眼睛和玫瑰色脸颊。平静的微笑看着镜头。她的浅棕色头发造型为{argument name="hairstyle" default="低辫子髻"}，带有细刘海。金色的背光照射在她的头发上，圆形的阳光照射在她的皮肤上。

服装/姿势：白色{argument name="dress type" default="wrap-style mini dress"}，深V领，腰部系丝带。她外面套了一件从肩上垂下来的透明白色雪纺长开衫。细节丰富的泡泡袖，袖口饰有褶边。她的双手自然地放在长椅上。

背景/灯光：前景是一张带有可见纹理的深棕色木凳。右边有一个象牙色的方形包。背景是一个公园，有深绿色的草坪和大树。来自左上角的强烈温暖的自然光在树叶上形成斑驳的阳光。背景树有圆形散景。

构图/相机：垂直 2:3 比例，从胸部高度看膝盖向上的肖像。脸位于上方中央。人像镜头的浅景深。

纹理/风格：高分辨率逼真的户外时尚照片。象牙色、暖肤色、深棕色和活力绿色是主要颜色。肩膀和膝盖上有亮点。详细的织物纹理和木凳纹理。

缺点：避免面部或微笑变形、多余的手指、四肢合并、不自然的阴影、徽标或水印。
items.prompt:
Subject: Bench in Dappled Sunlight

Main Subject: A bright portrait of a woman in her 20s sitting on a dark wooden bench in a {argument name="background" default="lush green park"}, captured vertically from head to crossed knees. The subject takes up much of the center frame. She faces forward with her head slightly tilted to her left, supporting herself with her hands on the bench seat. Her right leg is crossed over the left, creating a soft sitting posture.

Character/Expression: Small oval face, light ivory skin, brown eyes, and rose-colored cheeks. A calm smile looking at the camera. Her light brown hair is styled in a {argument name="hairstyle" default="low braided updo"} with thin bangs. Golden backlighting on her hair and round sun dapples on her skin.

She wears a sheer white chiffon long cardigan over it, falling off the shoulders. Detailed puff sleeves with frilled cuffs. Her hands rest naturally on the bench seat.

Strong warm natural light from the top-left-back creates sun dapples through the leaves. Background trees have circular bokeh.

items.promptZh: 为一位{argument name="character description" default="二十几岁的年轻东亚女性"}创作一幅柔和、自然的生活方式肖像，她在舒适的复古卧室里度过了一个慵懒的周末早晨。她站在门口或衣柜角落的中央，面对镜头，表情平静，略带俏皮的睡意，眼神清澈，妆容精致，皮肤纹理逼真。她的{argument name="hair style" default="长长的黑发松散地扎成低马尾辫，细细的发丝垂落在脸上"}应该看起来休闲且略显凌乱。她穿着一件宽松的纯白色短袖 V 领 T 恤和{argument name="pants" default="蓝黑格子宽松睡裤"}。她的手臂举过头顶，水平地抱着一个奶油色的大枕头，就像一个柔软的垫子放在她的头顶上。使用来自左侧的温暖漫射晨光，透明的白色窗帘占据画面的左边缘，营造出朦胧、柔和的光芒。房间小而温馨，配有深色木质装饰、灰白色墙壁，背景中悬挂着衣服，包括深色条纹毛衣、钩编背心和牛仔面料，以及靠近地板的深色手提箱或储物箱。添加精致的白色手绘涂鸦覆盖照片：正好 13 个可见的涂鸦元素，由手写文字 {argument name="doodle text" default="morning Chaos"}、文字附近和右上角的四颗小星星、两颗小心、一颗小兔子般的涂鸦、一弯新月、左边的一条虚线弯曲轨迹、右边的一条虚线弯曲轨迹和两个小闪光标记组成。将图像设计为亲密的偷拍胶片照片，具有柔焦、柔和的纹理、柔和的温暖、垂直 4:5 构图、无刺眼的对比度、无迷人的修饰、没有多余的人物、没有水印，并且除了涂鸦短语之外没有其他可读文本。
items.prompt: Create a soft, naturalistic lifestyle portrait of a {argument name="character description" default="young East Asian woman in her twenties"} spending a lazy weekend morning in a cozy vintage bedroom. She stands centered in a doorway or closet nook, facing the camera with a calm, slightly playful sleepy expression, clear eyes, subtle makeup, and realistic skin texture. Her {argument name="hair style" default="long black hair loosely tied in a low ponytail with wispy strands falling around her face"} should look casual and slightly messy. She wears a loose plain white short-sleeve V-neck T-shirt and {argument name="pants" default="blue-black gingham plaid loose pajama pants"}. Her arms are raised above her head, holding a large cream-colored pillow horizontally like a soft cushion resting over the top of her head. Use warm diffused morning light from the left, with a sheer white curtain occupying the left edge of the frame and creating a hazy, gentle glow. The room is small and homey with dark wooden trim, off-white walls, hanging clothes in the background including a dark striped sweater, a crocheted vest, and denim fabric, plus a dark suitcase or storage box near the floor. Add delicate white hand-drawn doodles overlaying the photo: exactly 13 visible doodle elements consisting of the handwritten words {argument name="doodle text" default="morning chaos"}, four small stars near the text and upper right, two tiny hearts, one small bunny-like scribble, one crescent moon, one dashed curved trail on the left, one dashed curved trail on the right, and two small sparkle marks. Style the image as an intimate candid film photograph with soft focus, mild grain, pastel warmth, vertical 4:5 composition, no harsh contrast, no glamour retouching, no extra people, no watermark, and no additional readable text beyond the doodle phrase.

items.prompt: 9:16 vertical orientation, artistic makeup portrait in an Oriental antique embroidery workshop, high-precision realistic photography using a giant circular embroidery frame as the foreground framing device. {argument name="subject" default="A clearly adult young Oriental female, visually aged about 25–28 years"} stands behind a large embroidery frame, her face and upper body visible through the floral patterns being embroidered. Colored silk threads extend from the edges toward the center, with an embroidery needle resting near her fingertips, capturing a moment in creation. One hand holds a slender gold needle, the other gently touches the falling threads, body leaning slightly forward, gaze looking straight through the frame into the camera—focused and soft, combining the poise of a noblewoman with the quiet power of a female creator. The character has a mature, natural Oriental classical bone structure, soft oval face, clear almond eyes with quiet light, and full lips. The makeup features a porcelain white base, preserving real skin texture. Eyeshadow is in peach pink and plum rose, with gold shimmer. Lips are finished with peach-red rose glass glaze. Black hair is styled in a lush classical bun with gold needles, white jade hairpins, and pearls. The clothing uses {argument name="clothing colors" default="pearl white, soft lotus purple, and light gold"}. The workshop is filled with wooden spools and metal needles, with a giant frame creating a natural scenic frame of embroidered peonies and butterflies. Soft warm white light falls from a skylight, with colored threads reflecting hues onto her face. Side lighting highlights her collarbone and waist, while the dark workshop background enhances the brightness of her skin and clothing.

items.title: 海滨度假泳装人像
items.promptZh:
主题：
{argument name="theme" default="中午在蔚蓝的海水旁放松身心"}

主要主题：
一幅垂直的度假村肖像，一位女士穿着{argument name="clothing" default="white Swimwear"}懒洋洋地躺在黑色木甲板上，甲板上伸出高度透明的蓝色大海，沐浴在阳光下。一条腿悬垂在水面上，而她坐着，另一只膝盖抬起。

人物/表情：
一个20多岁的女人。她的脸斜着向上，眼睛上戴着大大的棕色太阳镜。嘴唇微微张开，表情平静。自然、有光泽的皮肤，浅珊瑚色的嘴唇和微妙的健康光泽。她的头发是{argument name="hair style" default="有光泽的黑色长发"}，垂至胸前，在微风中散开在身后。

服装/姿势：
象牙白色比基尼上衣，配有细肩带、荷叶边和中央丝带领带。搭配带有精美褶边的配套短裤，一件薄薄的白色条纹罩衫宽松地披在肩上。她将上半身向后倾斜，用一只手支撑在甲板上。一条膝盖高高弯曲，另一条腿伸长，脚放在靠近水面的地方。两只脚踝上都戴着精致的银色脚链。

背景/灯光：
画面的大部分被清澈的海面占据，从绿松石色过渡到深蓝色。透过水面可以看到浅浅的海床和细小的波纹，夏季强烈的阳光在海面上反射出白色的光芒。甲板上她旁边有一顶蕾丝边草帽和一块柔软的芥末米色布料。来自高处的明亮自然光会产生轮廓分明的柔和阴影。

构图/相机：
垂直3:4。拍摄对象位于屏幕右下角，从左上角到顶部留有广阔的海洋空间。从头到脚捕捉全身的构图，甲板的角从右下角斜向延伸到中心。稍微抬高的视角，对角线向下看。拍摄清晰，主体和水面的图案清晰，而远处的海面则变得柔和。

质地/风格：
高分辨率逼真的度假时尚照片。精确描绘自然的皮肤纹理、纯粹的轻薄面料、精致的荷叶边和闪闪发光的水面。明亮清新的调色板以充满活力的蓝色和柔和的象牙色为中心。

负面：
手或脚变形；腿与水的不自然接触；扭曲的太阳镜
items.prompt:
Subject:

items.promptZh: 为一位开朗的日本年轻女性{argument name="character name" default="Hina"}创作一张明亮、自然的全身时尚照片，她穿着清爽的夏季日本水手风格校服在公共广场喷泉中。她有一头齐肩的深棕色头发，柔软的刘海，友善的开放笑容，清晰的年轻五官，以及双臂略微伸展以保持平衡的俏皮姿势。她的服装是一件清爽的白色短袖水手衬衫，领口和袖子有浅水蓝色条纹，配套的水蓝色领带，以及带有白色条纹饰边的高腰水蓝色百褶迷你裙；添加白色踝袜和闪亮的黑色乐福鞋。她正踏过浅水，一只脚抬起，溅起水花，周围环绕着许多垂直的喷泉喷射和闪闪发光的水滴。使用阳光明媚的夏日白天环境，潮湿的反光石头路面、背景中模糊的人、绿树以及喷泉后面柔和失焦的古典城市建筑。风格应该是写实的日本偶像照片/清新的夏日肖像，柔和自然的肤色，明亮通风的灯光，浅景深，清晰的主体焦点，闪闪发光的亮点，柔和的散景，垂直2:3构图，无文字，无水印，无多余肢体，保持统一朴素和干净。
items.prompt: Create a bright, naturalistic full-body fashion photo of a cheerful young Japanese woman, {argument name="character name" default="Hina"}, wearing a refreshing summer Japanese sailor-style school uniform in a public plaza fountain. She has shoulder-length dark brown hair with soft bangs, a friendly open smile, clear youthful features, and a playful pose with both arms slightly extended for balance. Her outfit is a crisp white short-sleeve sailor blouse with light aqua-blue collar and sleeve stripes, a matching aqua-blue necktie, and a high-waisted aqua-blue pleated mini skirt with white stripe trim; add white ankle socks and shiny black loafers. She is stepping through shallow water, one foot lifted and splashing, surrounded by many vertical fountain jets and glittering water droplets. Use a sunny summer daytime setting with wet reflective stone pavement, blurred people in the background, green trees, and a softly out-of-focus classical city building behind the fountain. Style should be realistic Japanese idol photo / fresh summer portrait, soft natural skin tones, bright airy lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp subject focus, sparkling highlights, gentle bokeh, vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra limbs, keep the uniform modest and clean.

items.title: 奇幻动物群像插画
items.promptZh:
目标：创作一幅细节丰富的手绘奇幻生物群像，采用奇趣故事书动画风格，画面以{argument name="central creature" default="a giant fluffy cream-white rabbit with long upright ears, tiny black oval eyes, and a gentle smile"}为中心，周围环绕许多友好的想象动物。

画布：宽幅 3:2 横向插画，满版，高细节，无边框，无文字。构图是密集且对称的群像，中央兔子略微靠前并居中，后方由较大生物围衬，前景边缘分布较小生物。

场景：一片繁茂的魔法草甸，位于浅而反光的池塘边缘，遍布芦苇、青草、长满苔藓的岩石、热带叶片、粉色莲状花、紫色花朵，以及散落在水边的小花瓣。背景中，左上方放置一棵被风吹拂的树，树后是仙人掌状植物和灌木，柔和蓝色山丘，淡蓝色天空与蓬松白云，右侧远处有一座雪顶山峰。使用{argument name="background setting" default="a bright alpine fantasy meadow with a pond, flowering plants, a lone tree, and a snowy mountain"}。

生物群像：包含恰好 26 个可见生物，排列如下：1 只巨大的奶油色兔子位于中央；2 只巨大的蓝色、似犀牛般的三角龙位于右后方，皮肤呈卵石状，有角、喙和带尖刺的颈盾；3 只大型灰色毛茸茸的巨魔怪物位于左后方，有橙色眼睛和露齿笑容；4 只棕色鬃毛狮子位于中左下方；5 只白灰相间的虎斑猫坐在兔子右侧；6 只小黑猫被抱在兔子胸前；7 只矮胖的黄色三角龙幼崽位于前方中央，有两只长侧角；8 只大型黄色、似美西螈的微笑生物位于右下方，四肢末端为黑色；9 只亮蓝色微笑恐龙幼崽位于中右侧；10 只红色带尖刺的狐蜥状生物位于最右侧前景；11 只灰色鸭嘴鸟状生物位于左中前景，张着嘴；12 只蓝色似蛙生物位于左下偏中，有黄色眼睛；13 只小绿蛙位于蓝蛙附近的一块岩石上；14 只长形红色蝾螈龙位于最左侧前景，有胡须和宽大的嘴；15 只长颈小绿蜥蜴位于左下方；16 只棕色圆胖蝾螈位于左下中央；17 只灰色圆胖蟾蜍在它旁边；18 只黄色斑点壁虎坐在下方中央；19 只微小的白色、似海豹的团状生物位于底部中右，有粉色耳朵；20 只微型企鹅状鸟站在黄色美西螈附近的紫色花朵旁；21 只小白鸟栖息在左侧花朵附近；22 只小鼠状生物从灰色巨魔附近的花丛中探头；23 只小猫头鹰状生物栖在巨魔肩上；24 只飞行翼龙状爬行动物位于右侧天空/草地区域；25 只橙色飞行昆虫状生物，有长肢，位于最右侧；26 个灰色小河马状头部从左侧蛙群后方的枝叶中探出。

视觉风格：保留温暖、怀旧的手绘动画概念艺术外观，具有可见笔触、水彩与水粉质感、柔和墨线般轮廓、绘画感枝叶、自然材质渲染、富有表现力的可爱面孔，以及友好的奇幻比例。使用{argument name="color palette" default="soft sky blues, moss greens, warm yellows, earthy browns, coral reds, and pink flower accents"}。光照为来自左上方明亮自然日光，带有柔和阴影和轻柔的大气纵深。氛围为{argument name="mood" default="cheerful, magical, gentle, and inviting"}。

约束：让所有生物可爱、易亲近而非可怕，具有圆润外形和富有表现力的眼睛。保持画面拥挤但清晰可读的群像，最大形体构成后排，最小形体沿前景池塘边缘分布。不要添加文字、标志、水印、人类、建筑或现代物品。
items.prompt:
Goal: Create a richly detailed hand-painted fantasy creature group portrait in a whimsical storybook animation style, featuring {argument name="central creature" default="a giant fluffy cream-white rabbit with long upright ears, tiny black oval eyes, and a gentle smile"} surrounded by many friendly imaginary animals.

Canvas: Wide 3:2 landscape illustration, full-bleed, high detail, no border, no text. The composition is a dense, symmetrical ensemble portrait with the central rabbit slightly forward and centered, framed by larger creatures behind and smaller creatures along the foreground.

Setting: A lush magical meadow at the edge of a shallow reflective pond, filled with reeds, grasses, mossy rocks, tropical leaves, pink lotus-like flowers, purple blossoms, and small petals scattered near the water. In the background, place a windswept tree on the upper left, cactus-like plants and shrubs behind it, soft blue hills, a pale blue sky with puffy white clouds, and a distant snow-capped mountain on the right. Use {argument name="background setting" default="a bright alpine fantasy meadow with a pond, flowering plants, a lone tree, and a snowy mountain"}.

Creature ensemble: Include exactly 26 visible creatures, arranged as follows: 1 giant cream rabbit in the center; 2 massive blue rhinoceros-like triceratops on the right rear with pebbled skin, horn, beak, and spiked frill; 3 large gray furry troll monster on the left rear with orange eyes and a toothy grin; 4 brown-maned lion in the lower middle-left; 5 white-and-gray tabby cat seated to the right of the rabbit; 6 small black cat held against the rabbit’s chest; 7 squat yellow baby triceratops in the front center with two long side horns; 8 large yellow axolotl-like smiling creature at lower right with black-tipped limbs; 9 bright blue smiling baby dinosaur at mid-right; 10 red spiky fox-lizard creature at far right foreground; 11 gray duck-billed bird creature at left-middle foreground with an open beak; 12 blue frog-like creature at lower left-center with yellow eyes; 13 small green frog on a rock near the blue frog; 14 long red salamander-dragon at far left foreground with whiskers and a wide mouth; 15 small green lizard with a long neck at lower left; 16 brown round salamander at bottom-left center; 17 gray round toad beside it; 18 yellow spotted gecko sitting at lower center; 19 tiny white seal-like blob creature with pink ears at bottom center-right; 20 miniature penguin-like bird standing beside purple flowers near the yellow axolotl; 21 tiny white bird perched near the left flowers; 22 small mouse-like creature peeking from flowers near the gray troll; 23 small owl-like creature perched on the troll’s shoulder; 24 flying pterosaur-like reptile in the right sky/grass area; 25 orange flying insect creature with long limbs on the far right; 26 small gray hippo-like head peeking from foliage on the left behind the frog group.

Visual style: Preserve a warm, nostalgic hand-painted animation concept-art look with visible brushwork, watercolor-gouache textures, soft ink-like outlines, painterly foliage, natural material rendering, expressive cute faces, and friendly fantasy proportions. Use {argument name="color palette" default="soft sky blues, moss greens, warm yellows, earthy browns, coral reds, and pink flower accents"}. Lighting is bright natural daylight from above-left, with gentle shadows and soft atmospheric depth. Mood is {argument name="mood" default="cheerful, magical, gentle, and inviting"}.

Constraints: Keep all creatures cute and approachable rather than scary, with rounded shapes and expressive eyes. Maintain a crowded but readable group portrait, with the largest figures forming the back row and the smallest figures along the foreground pond edge. Do not add text, logos, watermarks, humans, buildings, or modern objects.

items.title: 空心字形排版海报
items.promptZh: 将主题关键词解构为巨大的空心单线字形和引导笔画。这些线条横跨整个画面，并在主要拍摄对象的前景和背景之间编织。字形内部保持透明，使背景和主题可见。使用均匀的线条粗细、直角转弯、长弧线、箭头端点和点节点形成从顶部标题到中心主题再到底部信息区域的阅读路径，看起来既像文本又像路线图。少量正文应划分为干净的无衬线块，放置在字符空白附近或主题两侧，层次清晰。小信息标签和签名可以位于底部。所有文本都服务于节奏和音阶，而不压倒主要主题。\n\n文本：{argument name="text" default="我把我的心交给月亮"}
items.prompt: Deconstruct the theme keywords into giant hollow single-line glyphs and guiding strokes. The lines span the entire frame and weave between the foreground and background of the main subject. The glyph interiors remain transparent, allowing the background and subject to be visible. Use uniform line thickness, right-angle turns, long arcs, arrow endpoints, and dot nodes to form a reading path from the top title to the central subject and then to the bottom info area, appearing like both text and a roadmap. A small amount of body text should be divided into clean sans-serif blocks, placed near character white space or on both sides of the subject, with clear hierarchy. Small info tags and signatures can be at the bottom. All text serves the rhythm and scale without overpowering the main subject.\n\nText: {argument name="text" default="I give my heart to the moon"}

items.title: 日式蔬菜食谱海报
items.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese recipe infographic poster for {argument name="recipe title" default="4種野菜のスタミナガーリック炒め"}, with a warm hand-drawn cookbook aesthetic and perfectly legible Japanese typography.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 layout, off-white paper background, rounded corners, thin double green ornamental border with small leaf flourishes in the corners. Use soft watercolor-style food illustrations, friendly rounded Japanese fonts, dark brown main title text, green section ribbons, orange accents, dotted divider lines, and subtle sparkles.

Top header: Large centered headline text: {argument name="recipe title" default="4種野菜のスタミナガーリック炒め"}. Directly underneath, orange subtitle: {argument name="subtitle" default="（バター不使用版）"}. Add a small Japanese tagline below: "シャキッ！ほくっ！にんにく香る、食べごたえ抜群のスタミナおかず♪". Place a large illustrated cabbage on the upper left, a small garlic bulb icon near the upper right, and a black frying pan on the upper right filled with stir-fried cabbage, green bell pepper, potato slices, and garlic.

Main layout: Use five distinct content blocks arranged like a recipe card: 1 ingredients box at upper left, 1 preparation box at upper right, 1 cooking steps box at middle left, 1 technique tips box at middle right, and 1 serving memo box across the bottom.

Ingredients block: Green ribbon header "材料（2人分）". List exactly 10 ingredients with dotted leader lines and amounts: 1) キャベツ — 1/4玉（約250g）, 2) じゃがいも — 2個（約300g）, 3) ピーマン — 2個, 4) にんにく — 2かけ, 5) サラダ油 — 大さじ1, 6) ごま油 — 小さじ1, 7) しょうゆ — 大さじ1, 8) 鶏ガラスープの素 — 小さじ1, 9) 塩 — 少々, 10) こしょう — 少々. Include three small illustrations at the bottom of this box: green bell peppers, potatoes with one cut open, and garlic cloves.

Preparation block: Green ribbon header "下準備" with explanatory text: "じゃがいもはあらかじめ火を通しておくと、炒め時間が短くなり、味がしみ込みやすくなります。" Include exactly 2 preparation methods in rounded subcards. First green subcard titled "レンジで加熱する場合" with microwave icon and exactly 3 numbered steps: 1) じゃがいもは皮をむき、1.5cm幅の半月切りにする。 2) 耐熱容器に入れ、ふんわりとラップをかける。 3) 600Wで約5〜6分加熱する。 Add note: "※竹串がスッと通るくらいが目安です。" Second orange subcard titled "ゆでる場合" with pot icon and exactly 3 numbered steps: 1) じゃがいもは皮をむき、1.5cm幅の半月切りにする。 2) 鍋に水とじゃがいもを入れ、沸騰したら中火で3〜4分ゆでる。 3) ザルに上げて水気を切る。 Add note: "※固めに火を通すのがポイント！".

Cooking steps block: Orange ribbon header "作り方". Show exactly 7 numbered orange circles with Japanese step text: 1) キャベツはざく切り、ピーマンは縦にひと口大の細切りにする。にんにくは薄切りにする。 2) フライパンにサラダ油を中火で熱し、にんにくを炒める。香りが立ってきたら、じゃがいもを加えて焼き目がつくまで炒める。 3) ピーマンを加えてさっと炒める。 4) キャベツを加え、強めの中火でシャキッとするまで炒める。 5) 鶏ガラスープの素を加えて全体を炒め合わせる。 6) しょうゆを鍋肌から回し入れ、さっと絡める。ごま油を回しかけて香りをプラス。 7) 塩・こしょうで味をととのえ、全体をさっと混ぜて完成！ Add a tiny pan illustration near the lower right of this block with vegetables flying and a handwritten note "強火でサッと炒めてシャキッ！".

Technique tips block: Yellow-orange header "スタミナを盛る裏技" with sparkles. Include exactly 3 tip rows, each with an orange check icon and a small illustration on the right: 1) "にんにくは「香りを立てる」！" with garlic bulb, 2) "じゃがいもは「焼き目」をつける！" with potatoes, 3) "仕上げのごま油でコクUP！" with a sesame oil bottle labeled "ごま油". Use short explanatory Japanese text beneath each tip.

Bottom serving memo block: Green ribbon header "いただき方のメモ". Include the text "熱々のうちにどうぞ！ごはんが進む味つけで、スタミナ満点♪" and exactly 3 green check bullet points: 1) 白ごはんとの相性抜群！ 2) お弁当のおかずにも◎ 3) 冷めてもおいしいので、作り置きにもおすすめです。 Add three food illustrations along the bottom: a bowl of white rice, a plated serving of the vegetable garlic stir-fry, and a speech bubble saying "にんにくの香りと野菜の甘みで、やみつきになるおいしさです♪" with a small heart.

Visual constraints: Keep all Japanese text crisp and readable, maintain a balanced magazine-recipe layout, use no photographs, no watermark, no extra sections, and no additional ingredients or steps.

items.titleZh: 日系暖色四格情侣漫画
items.promptZh:
生成一套四格日式温馨漫画，干净的手绘动漫线条风格，温暖的米棕和浅棕单色色调，柔和的奶油色背景，简单柔和的阴影，整体温馨治愈的氛围。长宽比：正方形 1:1，标准 2x2 四面板布局，每个面板之间由细棕色边框分隔。顶部标题：大字“{argument name="title" default="Couple's Day"}”，两边各有一个小心形，手写的深棕色感觉。
【四版内容】
第 1 幅：一对年轻亚洲夫妇的站立肖像。 {argument name="malecharacter" default="man"}站在{argument name="femalecharacter"default="woman"}后面，双手轻轻放在她的肩膀上，两人都对着镜头微笑。
图2：这对夫妇坐在舒适的室内，双手拿着杯子，互相微笑。女子有一个清晰的中文对话气泡：“谢谢你一直陪着我。”白色圆形对话气泡，清晰的黑色文本。
第三组：夫妻俩一起在厨房做饭。并肩站在炉边，男人在搅动，女人在帮忙，表情专注而快乐。
第四幅：紧紧拥抱的情侣。男人低头轻轻吻着女人的额头，女人闭上眼睛微笑。
【字符一致性强制要求】
两个角色从第1组到第4组必须保持完全相同的面部、发型、服装和身体比例。不允许漂移。
男：短发，相貌温柔，穿着简单的毛衣或衬衫。
女：中长发，相貌温柔，穿着家居服。
[风格与质感]
干净的手绘动漫线条，单色暖米棕+浅棕+奶白，简单的阴影，像日本生活漫画或治愈系插画。
【文字要求】
对话气泡中的中文必须正确、清晰，无乱码、变形。避免：写实摄影、3D渲染、鲜艳色彩、复杂背景、人物脸部塌陷、乱码文字、廉价贴纸感。
items.prompt:
Generate a set of four-panel Japanese-style warm comics, clean hand-drawn anime line art style, warm rice-brown and light brown monochromatic tones, soft cream background, simple soft shadows, overall warm and healing atmosphere. Aspect ratio: square 1:1, standard 2x2 four-panel layout, separated by thin brown borders between each panel. Top title: large characters "{argument name="title" default="Couple's Day"}", with a small heart on each side, handwritten dark brown feel.
[Four-panel content]
Panel 1: Standing portrait of a young Asian couple. The {argument name="male character" default="man"} stands behind the {argument name="female character" default="woman"}, hands gently on her shoulders, both smiling at the camera.
Panel 2: The couple sitting in a cozy interior, holding mugs with both hands, smiling at each other. The woman has a clear Chinese dialogue bubble: "Thank you for always being with me." White rounded dialogue bubble, clear black text.
Panel 3: The couple cooking together in the kitchen. Standing side by side at the stove, the man stirring, the woman helping, expressions focused and happy.
Panel 4: The couple hugging tightly. The man bows his head to gently kiss the woman's forehead, the woman closes her eyes and smiles.
[Character Consistency Mandatory Requirements]
The two characters must maintain exactly the same face, hairstyle, clothing, and body proportions from Panel 1 to Panel 4. No drifting allowed.
Man: short hair, gentle looks, wearing a simple sweater or shirt.
Woman: medium-length hair, gentle looks, wearing home-style clothes.
[Style and Texture]
Clean hand-drawn anime line art, monochromatic warm rice-brown + light brown + cream white, simple shadows, like Japanese lifestyle manga or healing illustrations.
[Text Requirements]
The Chinese in the dialogue bubbles must be correct, clear, without garbled characters or deformation. Avoid: realistic photography, 3D rendering, bright colors, complex backgrounds, character face collapse, garbled text, cheap sticker feel.

items.promptZh: 使用 REFERENCE_0 作为角色基础，将其扩展为完整的插图户外场景，同时保持相同的粗体黑色轮廓、手绘纹理和可识别的角色设计。将角色从静态站立姿势变为步行姿势，右手握住 1 条红色皮带，脸上正好有 1 滴汗珠，表情略显疲倦。添加 1 只小狗，{argument name="dog Breed" default="Shiba Inu"}，牵着皮带走在角色前面，张着嘴，卷着尾巴，快乐而充满活力。将它们放置在 {argument name="setting" default="a sunny Riverside path"} 中：背后是蓝色的河流，沿岸有绿色的树木，沙地上散布着深色的石头，还有明亮的蓝色天空。在左上角添加 1 个白色卡通云。在右上角添加 1 个白色思维气泡，并带有 2 个小连接点，其中包含垂直日语文本 {argument name="thought bubble text" default="あつい..."}。保持构图以风景为导向，狗在左边，人物在右边，两人都面向左，就像一起走一样。保持厚实的油画/厚涂表面纹理、鲜艳的色彩、简单的卡通形状、厚实的黑色边框，并且没有照片写实感。
items.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the character base, expand it into a full illustrated outdoor scene while keeping the same bold black outline, hand-painted texture, and recognizable character design. Change the character from a static standing pose into a walking pose, holding exactly 1 red leash in their right hand, with exactly 1 sweat drop on the face and a slightly tired expression. Add exactly 1 small dog, {argument name="dog breed" default="Shiba Inu"}, walking in front of the character on the leash, happy and energetic with its mouth open and curled tail. Place them in {argument name="setting" default="a sunny riverside path"}: blue river behind them, green trees along the banks, sandy ground with scattered dark stones, and a bright blue sky. Add exactly 1 white cartoon cloud in the upper left. Add exactly 1 white thought bubble in the upper right with exactly 2 small connector dots, containing vertical Japanese text {argument name="thought bubble text" default="あつい..."}. Keep the composition landscape-oriented, with the dog on the left and the character on the right, both facing left as if walking together. Maintain a chunky oil-paint/impasto surface texture, vivid colors, simple cartoon shapes, thick black borders, and no photorealism.

items.title: 猎豹望斑马童书插画
items.prompt: Create a whimsical children's picture-book illustration in a rough hand-painted gouache/oil-pastel style on a 4:3 horizontal canvas. Show a large {argument name="animal character" default="cheetah"} in the left foreground, sitting on a gray-brown rock ledge and facing right, with a rounded cartoon body, golden-yellow fur, many black spots, a striped tail curled around the rock, a white muzzle, and very thick uneven black outlines like crayon or marker. The cheetah is looking across a sunny African savanna toward exactly 4 zebras in the mid-distance on the right, each small, black-and-white striped, walking in a loose line. Add exactly 3 white sky clouds with heavy black outlines: one medium cloud near the top center, one large long cloud near the top right, and one small cloud near the horizon. Above the cheetah's head place a large white cloud-shaped thought bubble with black outline, connected by exactly 2 small thought circles, containing bold black Japanese text: {argument name="thought bubble text" default="前菜、主菜、副菜、デザート…"}. The landscape should have a bright cyan-blue textured sky, a golden-yellow grassy plain with scattered scrub brush, one flat-topped acacia tree on the right horizon, dark green foliage and a tilted tree trunk at the far left edge, and spiky green grass in the lower right foreground. Use visible brush texture, thick impasto-like strokes, playful imperfect shapes, high saturation, simple composition, and a storybook mood, as if it could be a page from a picture book. Avoid photorealism, gradients, thin clean vector lines, extra animals, or extra text.
